I heard there's a suspicious pharmacist by the name of Mr. Do at Mu Lung...
Mr. Do claimed that he's the true student of Tae Sang and is a great pharmacist himself. The more I look at this character, the more I feel suspicious about him... anyway, he told me he's been working on combining rare herbs found at Mu Lung, and asked me to grab some The Book Ghosts and give him Old Paper along the way. Old Paper Old Paper 4000298/25
Once I gave him all the Old Papers needed for this, Mr. Do gave me a book that he authored, Book on Herbal Medicine, and told me if I bring this book to him when I visit him, he'll make the medicine for me in a heartbeat. He may not seem trustworthy, but I don't see what's wrong with asking him for a medicine every once in a while...

quests.name: No Gong's Test
quests.description:
The Head Physical Trainer of Mu Lung, No Gong, wants to test the students willing to become the Master...
No Gong told us the test consists of defeating both Grizzly and Panda. Grizzly and Panda may be animals, but they have both been training hard to become Masters, so this may not be a easy fight... Grizzly 38311# Panda 38312#
After successfully defeating Grizzly and Panda, I went back to No Gong to tell him the good news, only to listen to him tell me that I still have ways to go before becoming the true Master. What the, he's doing this again... is he really going to make me a Master, or what
quests.requirements: Defeat Grizzly x 100, Defeat Panda x 100

quests.name: Do Gong's Test
quests.description:
The Head Mental Trainer of Mu Lung, Do Gong, wants to test the students willing to become the Master...
To test out the skills the students have accumulated over time, Do Gong told us to defeat both The Book Ghost and Sage Cat. The Book Ghost and Sage Cat have both mastered the art of casting spells, becoming close to Masters themselves. They may be hard to handle... The Book Ghost 38321# Sage Cat 38322#
After defeating 100 The Book Ghosts and 100 Sage Cats, Do Gong told me I still have ways to go before becoming a true Master...
quests.requirements: Defeat The Book Ghost x 100, Defeat Sage Cat x 100

quests.name: Gathering Up the Lacking Ingredients
quests.description:
Mr. Ku of Herb Town told me he needed to tell me something.
Mr. Ku has been short on herbs that should be sent to Tae Sang due to the dastardly ways of Lord Pirate. Mr. Ku told me other herbs will be needed to replace the original herb, and asked me to gather up as much 100-Year-Old Bellflower as possible... 100-Year-Old Bellflower 100-Year-Old Bellflower 4000294
I wound up giving Mr. Ku 100-Year-Old Bellflower.

quests.name: Eliminating the Escaped Pot
quests.description:
Captain Hwang of Herb Town seems to be concerned about something...
Captain Hwang seemed concerned about the fact that the Jars prepared to place herbs in have instead been inhabited by an unknown creature, causing havoc around the area. He asked me to eliminate 400 Jars for him. Jar 38341#
After defeating 400 Jars, Captain Hwang seemed very pleased. I still havce no idea, however, what exactly was inside it...

quests.name: Tae Soo's Account
quests.description:
Tae Soo, the kid in charge of protecting the Peach Farm of Mu Lung, apparently experienced something very strange...
While aimlessly walking around Sky Forest, Tae Soo was ambushed by a terrifying wild bear. Almost injured, Tae Soo completely froze up, not knowing what to do, until a helping hand arrived...by the form of bear. Tae Soo wanted to know what that bear was all about, and asked me to talk to No Gong about him.
After hearing the story on the bear, No Gong had the heavy look of concern...

quests.name: No Gong's Student
quests.description:
No Gong had a student who was struck by a Goblin's spell and started attacking innocent people around the neighborhood, and his name is Tae Roon... the most intelligent student No Gong had ever taught. He is currently in exile out of this town, hoping for the spells to weaken as time goes by... No Gong suspected that since he helped Tae Soo out, the spell might be weakening the grip on him, and wanted me to confirm this with Do Gong.
Do Gong told me he'll do anything to help Tae Roon out. I better go talk to Do Gong once more.

quests.name: Do Gong's Spell
quests.description:
Do Gong thinks Tae Roon had been weakening the grip the spell has on him through meditation, so he believes that with his own set of spells, the previously-unbreakable spell of Master Goblin might finally be broken. In order for Do Gong to do the spell, however, he'll need some items to work with... Broken Deer Horn Broken Deer Horn 4000288/10 Old Paper Old Paper 4000298/10 Peach Seed Peach Seed 4000282/50
Do Gong started casting the spell... only to no avail. I better notify this to No Gong.
quests.requirements: Broken Deer Horn x 10, Old Paper x 10, Peach Seed x 50

quests.name: Defeat Tae Roon
quests.description:
Since Do Gong's spell was unfortunately interfered by Master Goblin, No Gong, with sadness in his eyes, told me the following... for the sake of Tae Roon, if he ever loses it again, he told me to take him down. Tae Roon 38381#
I went to go see No Gong again after defeating Tae Roon. No Gong believed that this would actually lighten the pressure Tae Roon might have felt with the spell controlling his every move. He said this with equal parts sadness and relief. Now that I have learned the truth about Tae Roon, I better go see Tae Soo once more.

quests.name: Tae Soo's Reward
quests.description:
After listening to Tae Roon's story, Tae Soo felt that since he owes Tae Roon a debt of gratitude, he wanted to give him a Peach from this farm. How can I successfully give Tae Soo's Peach to Tae Roon Maybe there's a place to drop the Peach at the Wild Bear Area...
A small note of thank you on the table... after handing Tae Soo the note, he flashed a big smile so genuine he must have felt like flying. This small piece of paper may well be the truth about Tae Roon.

quests.name: Weakening Master Goblin
quests.description:
The Head Mental Trainer of Mu Lung, Do Gong, seems to be concerned about something...
The source of awful concern for Do Gong was Master Goblin, who over the course of thousand years have digressed from a promising Master to a bona-fide Master Goblin. Do Gong pleaded with me to defeat Master Goblin, who's responsible for tricking Tae Roon and is primed to trcik his way into Mu Lung. In order to weaken Master Goblin, I'll first have to eliminate Sage Cats and recover cat dolls from the battle. Cat Doll Cat Doll 4000289/100
I managed to defeat the Sage Cats and recovered the cat dolls.After casting spells on those cat dolls, Do Gong wanted me to head to Goblin Forest 1 to see if the spells were casted right. Off to the Goblin Forest.

quests.name: Master Goblin's Call
quests.description:
As soon as I reach Goblin Forest 1, I can faintly hear a voice coming out of there...
Out of the blue, Master Goblin decided to speak to me. Master Goblin seemed eager to dispell the rumors and misconceptions held towards him... is he for real I should head over to the Rock Support of the Disappeared Statue at Goblin Forest 2 as Master Goblin instructed.
Master Goblin reiterated he had no hard feelings towards Mu Lung, and that all this hatred stems from Do Gong, who's jealous of Master Goblin's mastery on spells. No way... I better talk to Do Gong and find out myself.

quests.name: Do Gong's in Trouble
quests.description:
Master Goblin, who calls himself the King Sage Cat, proclaims that he's the true Master, and althought he may have been ridiculed by Do Gong, he was willing to let it slide and offer a truce. Also wanted to offer a miracle medicine to Do Gong as a sign of truce. Well, I better give Do Gong the red marble like he said.
The stuff Master Goblin gave to Do Gong wasn't the Miracle Medicine!!! It's a POISON!!! Will Do Gong be able to survive this I better check his pulse right now.

quests.name: Master Goblin's Questions
quests.description:
Due to being tricked by Master Goblin, I wound up giving the Red Marble to Do Gong, poisoning him in the process. This isn't true... how can he lie to me I better go back to see Master Goblin and ask him what's up!
Master Goblin offered to give me an antidoe marble if I manage to answer all three of questions... but the true answers were NOWHERE to be found. He NEVER meant to give me the antidote!! What should I do I better go see Do Gong now.

quests.name: Kino Konoko's Concern
quests.description:
Kino Konoko is responsible for taking care of a small altar over in Mushroom Shrine. She seems to be concerned about something...
Tired of cleaning up after those pesky Crows, Kino Konoko wants me to gather 100 Crow Feathers. I'd hate to see the Mushroom Shrine covered in filth, so I've decided to help her. Time to pluck some Crow Feathers! Crow Feather 4000064/100
I gave Kino Konoko a whole bunch of Crow Feathers. It felt good seeing her being ecstatic over a bunch of Kino Konokos. Hopefully this will restore Mushroom Shrine's beauty...

quests.name: Kino Konoko vs Fire Raccoon
quests.description:
Kino Konoko, who resides in the Mushroom Shrine, is having a bit of trouble with Fire Racoons. I should see if I can help!
Kino Konoko tells me that the food vendors and restaurants in Mushroom Shrine are suffering from Fire Raccoons attacking their places. I better help them out. I would not want to miss out on some great food around here! Now, where can I find Fire Raccoon Fire Raccoon 43011#
I let Kino Konoko know that I took care of 100 Fire Raccoons. She was ecstatic, to say the least. Hopefully that'll keep the Mushroom Shrine food from disappearing...

quests.name: Hanako's Foxtail Muffler 1
quests.description:
Hanako of Mushroom Shrine has an item she really would love to have. What must that be
It turns out that the item Hanako wants to have is a muffler made out of Cloud Foxtail. A muffler made out of Foxtails. Hmm...I don't get why she'd want to wear a muffler in such warm weather, but I did promise to get her Cloud Foxtails, She needs 100, so I'd better get started. So, that's 100 Cloud Foxtails... Cloud Foxtail 4000066/100
I gave Hanako 100 Cloud Foxtails. Hmmm, but this isn't as much as I thought. Can she really make a muffler out of this

quests.name: Hanako's Foxtail Muffler 2
quests.description:
Hanako, who wanted to make a Cloud Foxtail muffler, haven't finished making it. I wonder what she's lacking...
Hanako wanted to make a muffler out of Cloud Foxtail, so I gave her 100 Cloud Foxtails. Despite the work, Hanako flat-out insisted that she asked for 300 all along, and demanded that I get her 200 more. I didn't need to hear that from her, but I'll have to get her 200 more... 200 more Cloud Foxtails That's a lot! Cloud Foxtail 4000066/200
I gave Hanako 200 Cloud Foxtails. Hopefully this will do.

quests.name: Hanako's Foxtail Coat
quests.description:
Hanako seemed to be dissatisfied with just having a Cloud Foxtail muffler, and wants something more. What would that be...
It turns out Hanako wanted not just a Cloud Foxtail muffler, but a Cloud Foxtail coat. Seriously, why does she need a coat at Mushroom Shrine... This defies anyone's logic, but oh well... How am I going to gather up 400 Cloud Foxtails Cloud Foxtail 4000066/400
I gave Hanako 400 Cloud Foxtails. I understand her need for pretty things, but wearing a muffler AND a coat at Mushroom Shrine Hanako's just weird.

quests.name: Eliminating Dark Cloud Fox
quests.description:
The 'best-dressed' lady of Mushroom Shrine, Hanako, seems to be perturbed at something...
I found Hanako enraged - it appears her newly-purchased fabric was destroyed by a pack of Big Cloud Foxes. For someone as vain as she is, this is devastating. As a result, I promised her to eliminate 100 Big Cloud Foxes for her. The things I do for friends... Big Cloud Fox 43051#
Hanako seemed thankful for me eliminating 100 Big Cloud Foxs. She must have bought some new fabric already.

quests.name: The Lantern at Mushroom Shrine
quests.description:
Hikari, a proud resident of Mushroom Shrine, seems to be annoyed by something.
Hikari was indeed annoyed by something. She was disturbed that the Worn Paper Lanterns that are being used at Mushroom Shrine is apparently stuck with ghosts. This isn't annoying; this is downright creepy. I better kill 100 Paper Lantern Ghosts and get her some Worn Paper Lanterns, just the way Hikari said. Paper Lantern Ghost 43061# Worn Paper Lantern 4000222/50
I eliminated Paper Lantern Ghost and got some Worn Paper Lanterns for use. The more I think about it, I think Paper Lantern Ghost is much more of a dangerous presence than an unlit street at night.
quests.requirements: Defeat Paper Lantern Ghost x 100, Worn Paper Lantern x 50

quests.name: Eliminating Ghosts
quests.description:
Hikari of Mushroom Shrine seems to have something to tell me. I wonder what it is...
Hikari told me I have a whole bunch of Nightghosts around me. That's creepy, to say the least. I better kill off 100 Nightghosts right now. Nightghost 43071#
After letting Hikari know that I've killed 100 Nightghosts, she tells me that there aren't any Nightghosts hovering around me. Phew...

quests.name: Water Goblin's Cucumber
quests.description:
Hikari's farm, located at Mushroom Shrine, seems to have been robbed. What happened
Hikari states that the only items stolen at her farm are the Cucumbers, and she was very confident that it was the work of Water Goblin. She asked me to eliminate 100 Water Goblins and recover 50 Cucumbers in the process. A monster that prefers to eat Cucumber Interesting, especially since most kids hate that Water Goblin 43081# Cucumber 4000223/50
After eliminating Water Goblins and recovering a whole bunch of Cucumbers, Hikari had the look of satisfaction on her face.
quests.requirements: Defeat Water Goblin x 100, Cucumber x 50

quests.name: Eliminating Blue Mushmom
quests.description:
Mushroom Shrine is apparently in deep trouble. I better go see Hikari.
Apparently, out of numerous mushrooms that reside in Mushroom Shrine, a few of them turned into mutants, ultimately becoming Blue Mushmom. Hikari was worried that the town was going through a lot of trouble because of them, and wanted me to eliminate Blue Mushmoms. Blue Mushmoms are located at Hall of Mushroom. Blue Mushmom 43091#
I eliminated Blue Mushmoms as ordered and reported them to Hikari. Those mushrooms were indeed very hard to handle.

quests.description:
Paperboy is apparently handing out flyers that contain the breaking news...

I asked Rooney to inquire more on the stuff written on the flyer.

quests.name: Urban Jungle
quests.description:
There's a Masked Man in New Leaf City... what's his deal
I spoke with Jack Masque, he's a bandit prince from Amoria. He's in love with Princess Restless, and is trying to win her love from afar. He's got a passionate hatred for Wolf Spiders, as one bit her just as she was giving him a kiss. So, I've agreed to hunt down 100 Wolf Spiders in return for his thanks and something special he picked up. I should be able to find them in the MesoGears...
+Phew* I wiped out 100 of those pesky Wolf Spiders, and in return, I received a Leaf Crystal from Jack Masque. I can come back every 72 hours to help him if I want. I wonder what he did to get kicked out of Amoria...

quests.name: Subani's Legacy - Discovery
quests.description:
I heard there's an adventurer over at the MesoGears underneath Bigger Ben. What mysteries does it hold I should find out!
I spoke with the famous John Barricades' one-half of the world famous Barricade Bros. Treasure Hunting Co. He spoke to me about Subani, the legendary mage responsible for the Dark Scrolls throughout the Maple World. He believes there is something within the MesoGears that may be a treasure of his. I've agreed to help clear the way. I'll have to defeat 50 Killa Bees, 30 Mighty Maple Eaters and 40 Fire Tusks so I can explore deeper into the MesoGears...
I cleared a path straight through the MesoGears, and now I can explore there in peace. When I'm ready, I can see John Barricade to continue with the next part of this adventure!
quests.requirements: Defeat Killa Bee x 50, Defeat Mighty Maple Eater x 30, Defeat Fire Tusk x 40

quests.name: Subani's Legacy - Transgression
quests.description:
John Barricade is awaiting me at the Temple Hive! He's found something!
I spoke with John, and he's found a set of weird markings in the MesoGears that he can't decipher. He's mentioned that he'll need special crystals known as Hyper Glyphs. I've agreed to snag 50 of them so he can decipher the markings. Electrophants...John thinks that the mechanism on their heads may have those Hyper Glyphs inside. I'd better be careful-I don't want to get shocked!
I got the 50 Hyper Glyphs that John needed, and he's hard at work deciphering the markings. I should come back soon to see if he's finished!

quests.name: Subani's Legacy - Deliverance
quests.description:
John has finished deciphering the markings! I need to get back to the Temple Hive now!
John and I spoke again, and something unforeseen happened. I'll have to track down 50 MesoGears Map Pieces so he can put together the map! He mentioned the robots he "borrowed" for some assistance went all crazy, kept saying "I.AM.ROBOT" as they scurried into the Krakian Jungle...
Finally done! I took the pieces back to John, and he's going to start piecing the map together. However, he did come across a strange ring that passed on to me. If this was the first treasure, I wonder where the rest is...

quests.name: Lost!
quests.description:
There's a mysterious traveler in New Leaf City-he doesn't look like he's from anywhere around here. I should ask him what's going on. It could be interesting...
I spoke with Elpam Gorlab, and he's a traveler from Versal, the mirror-world of MapleStory. He traveled here to observe us and our celebration, but due to the appearance of Amoria, he was thrown off-course and landed in New Leaf City. I've agreed to help get him home by collecting 30 Elpam Magnets. He's mentioned that the only creatures that have them here are the Barnard Grays. I'll have to head to Omega Sector and track them down. I didn't know that there was a mirror-world...I wonder if I have a double there...
I got the 30 Elpam Magnets and returned them to Elpam. In return, he gave me an Elpam Elixir, something that's sure to help me. It looks like he needs more help though...

quests.name: ReVersal
quests.description:
Elpam has adjusted his compass, but he still needs my help. I should travel back and see what he needs!
I went back to Elpam for more information, and he's explained that while he was able to adjust the compass, he needs to head back to the moment of his travel glitch to get back to his home safely. I have to hunt down 60 Temporal Fragments and hand them over. That's a full minute and the perfect amount of time for him to travel back. The Tick-Tock monsters should have them, since they tend to keep time. HA!
I got all 60 Temporal Fragments and returned them to Elpam. In return, he's given me a very nice prize he found floating in the rift...!

rewards.name: Dark scroll for Gloves for ATT

quests.rewards_items: Dark scroll for Gloves for ATT

quests.name: Featherweights
quests.description:
Icebyrd looks like he needs my help. I'd better get over to New Leaf City and see him!
I spoke with Icebyrd, and he was glad to see me. He's been trying to build the new areas, but the Gryphons have been wreaking havoc on the construction crews. If that wasn't enough, those pesky Boomers are also attacking the machines. I've agreed to help by taking out 100 Gryphons (located in the Highlands) and Boomers for 150 Boomer Core (located in the Badlands) to show them that this city is off-limits!
Man, what a day. I de-clawed the Gryphons and defused the Boomers. Now the city can continue building in peace. Icebyrd said that they may act up again, so I should come back to see if they've been rowdy...
quests.requirements: Defeat Gryphon x 100, Boomer Core x 150

quests.name: Cleaning Up The Streets
quests.description:
There's a new sheriff in New Leaf City. I should go see who it is!
I met the new sheriff, Lita Lawless. She's an old friend of Icebyrd's, and has taken over as the new sheriff. I've agreed to help her get this town in order, by wiping out 200 Electrophants and 200 Gryphons in New Leaf City. I'd better get started!
I...I did it! 200 of Electrophants and Gryphons has fallen to my might! In addition to that, I got a cool item from Lita as a 'Thank You!' I can return and help her anytime I want from now on...
quests.requirements: Defeat Gryphon x 200, Defeat Electrophant x 200
quests.rewards_items: Nocturnal Staff, 1000x Diamond Arrow for Bow, 1000x Diamond Arrow for Crossbow, White Identity, Onyx Blade

quests.name: Urban Warrior
quests.description:
This is Icebyrd Slimm, mayor of New Leaf City. I want to thank you for helping us get the city up and running. I have something for you, so come see me immediately!
As a bonus for helping get the city up and running, Icebyrd has given me a Warrior's Throne! This is sure to help me in the battles to come!
As a bonus for helping get the city up and running, Icebyrd has given me a Warrior's Throne! This is sure to help me in the battles to come!

quests.name: Urban Jungle - Continued
quests.description:
There's a Masked Man in New Leaf City... what's his deal
I spoke with Jack Masque, he's a bandit prince from Amoria. He's in love with Princess Restless, and is trying to win her love from afar. He's got a passionate hatred for Wolf Spiders, as one bit her just as she was giving him a kiss. So, I've agreed to hunt down 100 Wolf Spiders in return for his thanks and something special he picked up. I should be able to find them in the Temple Hive...
*Phew* I wiped out 100 of those pesky Wolf Spiders, and in return, I received a Leaf Crystal from Jack Masque. I can come back every 72 hours to help him if I want. I wonder what he did to get kicked out of Amoria...

quests.name: Cleaning Up The Streets - Continued
quests.description:
There's a new sheriff in New Leaf City. I should go see who it is!
I met the new sheriff, Lita Lawless. She's an old friend of Icebyrd's, and has taken over as the new sheriff. I've agreed to help her get this town in order, by wiping out 200 Electrophants and 200 Gryphons in New Leaf City. I'd better get started!
I...I did it! 200 of Electrophants and Gryphons has fallen to my might! In addition to that, I got a cool item from Lita as a 'Thank You!' I can return and help her anytime I want from now on...
quests.requirements: Defeat Gryphon x 200, Defeat Electrophant x 200

quests.name: Welcome to New Leaf City Quiz - END
quests.parent: Welcome to New Leaf City Quiz
quests.description:
I've successfully solve all the questions but I am still curious of some things...
I was talking with Icebyrd Slimm and wow, there is more to this land of Masteria and New Leaf City than what I learned from the quiz. I want to know more of what happened in this place.
I've asked about the old fable of Masteria and Icebyrd Slimm didn't quite answer my question. Maybe when I become stronger, he will tell me more about it.

quests.name: Brand Materia
quests.description:
Looks like the Glimmer Man is looking for a rare material from the alternate dimension of Versal, the very White Versal Materia that I now possess. Perhaps I should visit him in New Leaf City and see what he wants with it. Maybe he'll reward me for bringing him some...
I visited the Glimmer Man, and discovered that he's an ultra-powerful mage whose ability to turn his entire body into pure diamond (hence his name) has allowed him to journey to space and other inhospitable environments. Through the vast knowledge he's acquired during his explorations, he's also become somewhat of a renowned weapons creator and arms dealer. The Glimmer Man has landed in Masteria looking for something called White Versal Materia, a rare element from the alternate dimension of Versal he's been dying to experiment with. To thank me for recovering some and bringing it to him, he's promised to make me a weapon of my own from it. However, I've got to also track down 7 Black Crystals and return these to him as well. Only then can he reduce the naturally unstable Materia down to a useable form. A weapon made from an otherwordly material! I wonder what it does...
I returned to the Glimmer Man and he synthesized the White Versal Materia and the 7 Black Crystals I gave him to form a Materia Orb. He's said his precocious friend Spindle can turn this into a weapon, so I should see him when I'm ready to make the weapon...WOOT! Spindle is currently residing in the Omega Sector. Additionally, anytime I find more White Versal Materia, I can bring it to the Glimmer Man and he'll create another Materia Orb for me so I can make another weapon!
quests.requirements: White Versal Materia x 1, Black Crystal x 7

quests.name: Interstellar Relics
quests.description:
a
Professor Foxwit spoke with me about the space-based Artifacts suddenly being discovered. He's believes he can invent new and different items with them by using the knowledge he's acquired over years of time-travel. He is willing to experiment on any Artifacts I should find. If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and give me a blueprint to make it...

He's believes he can invent new and different items with them by using the knowledge he's acquired over years of time-travel. He is willing to experiment on any Artifacts I should find. If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and give me a blueprint to make it...

quests.name: Ancient Artifacts
quests.description:
John Barricade has told me about the Ancient Artifacts I've found in my offline travels (playing the MapleStory Trading Card Game). He thinks that these can be used to construct powerful weapons and items. If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and how to make them.

quests.name: Jay's Curiosity
quests.description:
It's weird... When I walked passed Jay from Henesys the other day, he didn't answer my greetings and didn't even notice me there. It looked like he was working on some kind of riddle by himself. Let's find out what Jay is up to these days.
I don't believe I actually offered to help him on finding a historical figure just out of curiosity! I guess it won't hurt to check out the dungeon as Jay requested... But I really doubt I would find anything there. It's a legend, myth, a fairy tale.
I found Bob from Drake's Meal Table and talked with bunch of people about him. He is famous around this world.
quests.rewards_items: Bob's Snail Shell, Bob's Snail Shell

quests.name: Gwin's Thanks
quests.description:
When I passed by, Gwin, someone I really never got to spoke with, looked like he had something to talk to me. Let's go and find out what he has to say to me.
Gwin was looking at Bob's Snail Shell very closely to see if I did anything to hurt him. I don't know what the deal is but he was scaring me. It makes me wonder why he is obsessed with this particular snail. I should find out by talking to Gwin again.
Gwin told me what happened between him and Bob. It's amazing that a simple snail actually tried to save human being... Those little monsters we hunt aren't really little at all...

quests.name: The Rememberer's Passion Part 1
quests.description:
The Rememberer sure would know who Bob is. He's the Rememberer! I should talk with The Rememberer to find out what he knows.
The Rememberer isn't relly being helpful today. Very slow talking, not really informative. I wonder why he is so... depres
He is MEAN! MEAN, MEAN, MEAN! He took away Bob's Snail Shell from me wtihout me letting him! Now, what do I have to do

quests.name: The Rememberer's Passion Part 2
quests.description:
I found it! I found Bob again! He must have escaped from The Rememberer by himself! I feel really terrible that I let this kind of things happen. I am going back to The Rememberer to tell him to lighten up.
I don't think The Rememberer gets the whole idea of me doing this. Bob may be just another monster but I know what is right or wrong. And I am going to pay back just the way he did to me. I need to get 1 Snail Shell other than Bob's to pull this off.
I got him! The Remeberer will always remember this day. The day he got tricked by me! Ok. I should stop doing things like this though.
quests.requirements: Snail Shell x 1, Bob's Snail Shell x 1

quests.name: Grendel The Really Old's Glorious Days
quests.description:
Grendel The Really Old... He lives deep in the forest of Ellinia. Since he's really old, he has to know SOMETHING about Bob. I shall see him now.
Grendel The Really Old was talking out of himself but I got to make him hear what I had to say. He is getting glasses. I hope his eyesight isn't too bad to recognize Bob... After all, Grendel is probably the oldest guy in this world.
Grendel The Really Old got very mad at me for hitting Bob to make him go into his shell. I knew he would know something but never would have guessed they were old friends. I guess I owe Bob a big apology. But how am I going to be able to do that to a snail, especially if he's not coming out from his shell

quests.name: Bruce's Research
quests.description:
Bruce, the monster researcher, might know something. Maybe he can tell me how old Bob actually is. If I get to know how old he is, wouldn't that be a discovery of something remarkable
He does seem to know something about his age but he looks spooked. I shouldn't hesitate to ask him what is wrong!
Wow... Bruce told me that Bob's age is incalculable. This is getting serious, isn't it. A snail that even professional monster researcher can't tell the age. Maybe he was right about asking me to go see Winston. Maybe an archeologist knows more about the history and the age issue than Bruce.

quests.name: Dances with Balrog's Barbarism Part 1
quests.description:
This is a wild guess but... Wouldn't Dances with Balrog know a little bit about Bob Who knows, I heard that he likes snails. Maybe I will go check with him.
I didn't know Dances with Balrog likes to EAT the snails... Now, what am I suppose to do ! It doesn't look like he is going to give me back Bob's Snail Shell anytime soon...
I had to take off from Dances with Balrog. Who can STAND all that endless talking I should figure out a way to get Bob back other than talking him through...

quests.name: A Word to the Wise
quests.description:
I hear that Old Man Tom has been hearing noises from the old Prendergast Mansion on the outskirts of New Leaf City. A haunted house Sounds like the perfect Halloween adventure!
Old Man Tom told me about the haunted Prendergast Mansion. Apparently, the doors won't open for just anyone... I've got to figure out how to get in. Tom mentioned that the toymaker Prendergast used to hold parties for kids for holidays, including Halloween costume parties around this time of year. Maybe if I wear a costume I can get in! Hmmm... Now where can I buy one
I made it into the old Prendergast Mansion, against the advice of Old Man Tom. I wonder why he's so dead set on keeping people out of the house Maybe if I explore the house, I can find out more about what happened here...

quests.name: The Past in the Present
quests.description:
a
Jonas gave me his Toy Workshop Key. He wants me to find someone who will keep it safe and ensure that his twisted toys can't escape his house.
Turns out Old Man Tom is Thomlin Prendergast, Jonas' younger brother. I gave him Jonas' Toy Workshop key to keep. He gave me Sophilia's Necklace, for helping put the spirits in Prendergast Mansion to rest.

quests.name: A Cold Hearth
quests.description:
I heard there's an old butler in the Haunted House. Maybe he needs help cleaning it...
I spoke with Edmunds, Butler of the Prendergast Estate. It seems that he' run out of Firewood to heat the house, which would explain the chill. I've agreed to help him out and bring back 60 Firewood so he can refill the fireplaces throughout the house and re-heat the mansion.
I brought back 60 Firewood to Edmunds; he can get the fireplaces going again now. Hmmm... It seems like there are quite a few fireplaces around this labyrinthine house.

quests.name: Eat This!
quests.description:
I keep seeing these fireplaces around the house. I wonder if they lead anywhere...maybe Edmunds knows He mentioned something about a key. I should press him a bit more.
My hunch was right. The fireplaces are interconnected through the mansion's Chimney; perhaps I can use them as an alternate way of navigating through the house. However, they're locked and Edmunds holds the only key. He will reluctantly give me the key if I collect 20 of each type of Gummy Slimes. There's Red, Green, Purple and Orange ones; so I'll need to hunt all over the house to get them. It'll be tempting to eat them first.
Edmunds reluctantly gave me the Omni Key after I collected the Gummy Slimes for him. With it, I can enter the fireplaces throughout the house and the Chimney to which they all connect. Hmmm... who knows where all these fireplaces lead
quests.requirements: Red Gummy Slime x 20, Green Gummy Slime x 20, Purple Gummy Slime x 20, Orange Gummy Slime x 20

quests.name: Special Delivery
quests.description:
There's a beautiful woman in the Prendergast house that looks mildly annoyed... perhaps I should speak with her.
Man! I spoke-no, tried to speak with Ludmilla, and she wouldn't give me the time of day until I agreed to get her 5 slices of Cherry Pie for Jonas from Olde Sapp Village. A bit strange that she referred to New Leaf City as that, but Miki should have them at the potion shop. What a cranky woman...
Well, I got Ludmilla her Cherry Pie, and learned a bit about Jonas and her love...for his money. No wonder Edmunds hates her. I should press that woman for more info about what's going on around here.

quests.name: Family Jewels
quests.description:
Oh...looks like Ludmilla is not quite done with me yet. I'd better head back and see what that nag wants now...
I spoke with Ludmilla, and big surprise---her Cherry Pie Ghoulash didn't lure Jonas out. I think he probably pushed a bookcase in front of the door to ensure he never sees her again, but that's just a theory. At any rate, it looks like now her prized jewelry has mysteriously disappeared. She thinks Sophilia's taken it, but I'm not sure if I buy that, seeing as how she's...not around to do that. I have to gather 20 Tarrymore Earrings and 10 Sepha Earrings and bring them back to her. The woman complains way too much... sheesh.
I found Ludmilla's beloved jewelry for her. In return she gave me a worn, but well-loved doll. It's seen better days, but it has charm. Someone is probably looking for this...
quests.requirements: Tarrymore Earring x 20, Sepha Earring x 10

quests.name: A Lost Girl
quests.description:
There's a girl wandering around the Prendergast Mansion. I wonder what she's looking for
Sophilia is looking for her favorite toy - the very first doll her father made for her when she was a child. She seems to have been looking for it for quite awhile. She mentioned something about Ludmilla having a history of hiding her toys. If I can find Sophilia's doll for her, maybe I can put her spirit at ease.
I gave Sophilia back her favorite doll. She was so happy to get it back that she gave me some of her favorite candy.

quests.name: A Father's Love
quests.description:
Jonas gave me a new doll he made to give to his daughter. I don't think Sophilia'll like it as much her favorite one, but I guess I should give it to her anyway, per her father's wishes.
I gave Sophilia the new doll her father made. It made her sad. She asked me give Annabelia, the first doll Jonas made for her, back to her father.
Jonas was very confused by the doll I gave him. He was almost speechless. I hope he is not going any more insane than he is right now.

quests.name: The M-Files
quests.description:
I heard there's a MBI (Maple Bureau of Investigation) agent in the Phantom Forest! I should investigate what he's investigating!
I spoke with MBI Agent Falcon. He's on the trail of a dangerous specter, but it looks like that crafty ghost gave him the slip by scattering his Paranormal Activity Report Pages all over the place. I've agreed to collect 50 of them so he can continue the hunt!
I tracked down all 50 of Agent Paranormal Activity Report Pages that he asked for! In return, he's given me Smores! Mmm...if only he had a napkin...

quests.name: File Under Incomplete
quests.description:
MBI Agent Falcon is still snooping around the old Haunted House, even after I helped him find some of the Paranormal Activity Report Pages! I wonder why... maybe he still needs help.
Looks like MBI Agent Falcon spoke too soon... 50 pages led him to the wrong, uh, dead guy... but he thinks that if I collect 100 more of them, he'll be able to catch Mr. Bones for sure! Whew... 100 pages. I wonder how many pages in total were in his original report
I tracked down all of the 100 more Paranormal Activity Report Pages Agent Falcon requested! Now he can finally go track Mr. Bones... I hope.

quests.name: The File Thickens Part 1
quests.description:
Agent Falcon is still hanging out in front of the Haunted House ! Doesn't he have other ghosts to catch, myths to debunk Maybe I should go see if something's wrong...
I'm starting to think that Agent Falcon spends too much time writing reports, and not enough time doing actual investigative work! The elusive Mr. Bones turns out to be Prendergast, the former owner of this house! Falcon wants me to find Jonas in the Haunted House, give him this Paranormal Subject Questionnaire to fill out, and return the completed form to him.
I got my questionnarie from Jonas. Now is time for me to hand over this document to Falcon. Maybe he can go back to MBI if I hand him this

quests.name: The Infernal Toy Machine
quests.description:
I keep hearing the groans and bellows of machinery echoing through the house. What is making this racket Is it where these infernal toys are coming from
I found Jonas Prendergast in his Toy Workshop at the top of the house, in front of a huge toy machine which seems to be the source of all these infernal toys! It seems that his machine is not functioning properly. If I collect 50 Firewood, 25 Screws, and 25 Loaded Springs, Jonas can build the replacement part to get his machine working properly again. I know that the Rocking Horses will have the Firewood and the Psycho Jacks will have the Screws and Loaded Springs. I've got to get what Jonas needs-perhaps this will stop it from churning out all these crazy toys!
I collected the parts Jonas needed to fix his machine. I hope I haven't simply helped a madman create more of his messed up toys.
quests.requirements: Screw x 25, Firewood x 50, Loaded Spring x 25

quests.name: In Her Likeness
quests.description:
Looks like Jonas fixed the machine... yet it's still cranking out these crazy toys. Maybe he is bonkers. Or maybe he needs some more help.
Looks like Jonas needs help building a new doll, a more perfect likeness of Sophilia. I don't think he realizes she's dead. In any case, I have to collect 30 Locks of Doll's Hair, 10 Heartstoppers, 10 Maple Candies, and 10 Pumpkin Taffies. Why the candies I may never know...
I collected everything Jonas needed to build his new doll in the likeness of his daughter. I have to say though... it looks nothing like her.
quests.requirements: Heartstopper x 10, Pumpkin Taffy x 10, Lock of Doll's Hair x 30, Maple Pop x 10

quests.name: Reparations
quests.description:
Jonas was very confused by the doll I gave him. He was almost speechless. I hope he is not going any more insane than he is right now.
When I gave Sophilia's favorite doll to Jonas, it seemed to have awaken him from his madness. He's realized that his Toy Machine has been corrupted and is churned out twisted versions of his former creations. Because the machine can't be destroyed, Jonas has asked me to destroy as many of his creations as possible. For every 50 Psycho Jacks, 50 Nightmares, or 50 Sophilia Dolls I destroy, Jonas has promised to reward me with something special.
Jonas gave me all of his Toymaker Gear in return for helping him destroy his twisted creations. He also gave me the key to his Toy Workshop, asking me to give it to someone who will help keep it safe and find a way to restore the Prendergast name.

quests.name: Psycho Jack
quests.description:
When I gave Sophilia's favorite doll to Jonas, it seemed to have awaken him from his madness. He's realized that his Toy Machine has been corrupted and is churned out twisted versions of his former creations. Because the machine can't be destroyed, Jonas has asked me to destroy as many of his creations as possible. For every 50 Psycho Jacks, 50 Nightmares, or 50 Sophilia Dolls I destroy, Jonas has promised to reward me with something special.
Looks like he wants me to destroy 50 Psycho Jacks. It shouldn't be too hard, I think.
I destroyed some of Jonas' creations and he rewarded me with some of his fantastic Toymaking gear! It seems like a grim endless battle against the tireless Infernal Toy Machine...

quests.name: Halloween : Entering the house
quests.description:
I've made it into the Prendergast Mansion! I don't know what Old Man Tom would react to my success though...
I've made it into the Prendergast Mansion! I don't know what Old Man Tom would react to my success though...
I've made it into the Prendergast Mansion! I don't know what Old Man Tom would react to my success though...

quests.description:
a
I got my questionnarie from Jonas. Now is time for me to hand over this document to Falcon. Maybe he can go back to MBI if I hand him this
I gave Agent Falcon's Paranormal Subject Questionnaire to Jonas and had him fill it out. Finding him in the labyrinthine mansion was the hard part... Jonas was actually quite cooperative, especially for a spirit. In any case, I returned the completed form to Falcon, who was ecstatic that he didn't have to set foot inside the creepy old mansion again.

However, they're locked and Edmunds holds the only key. He will reluctantly give me the key if I collect 20 of each type of Gummy Slimes. There's Red, Green, Purple and Orange ones; so I'll need to hunt all over the house to get them. It'll be tempting to eat them first.

quests.name: Smores No More
quests.description:
MBI (Maple Bureau of Investigation) Agent Falcon has been standing in front of the Prendergast Mansion for quite some time. Maybe I should go see why he's still loitering around.
Looks like the bumbling MBI Agent Falcon just can't get a break. Just when he was ready to pack up and leave to report the findings for his Halloween mission, a mysterious little boy appeared and stole all the Smores Falcon had cooked up for his colleagues! Falcon has agreed to pay you 100,000 mesos (from his Agency discretionary account) if you recover 25 of his Smores for him. Easy money - or is it The Smores look pretty tasty... I guess I'll have to try not to eat them myself as I collect them!
I collected Agent Falcon's Smores for him... they were a bit dirty but still good, so his colleagues back at the MBI Agency should be happy! In return, Falcon paid me the 100,000 mesos he promised. He also gave me some old medicine bottles that he'd found lying outside the house. They look pretty potent...

quests.name: Dinner Fixins'
quests.description:
It's time for Thanksgiving and I'm ready for some home cookin'! I should pay Mom and Dad a visit over in Henesys!
I'm helping Mom and Dad make Thanksgiving dinner! I have to gather one of each ingredient: 1 ear of Corn, a can of Cranberry Sauce, a Mashed Potato, bowl of Gravy and best of all, Stuffing Scoop. They promised me an Allowance if I return quickly. I guess the Turkeys stole all the ingredients to make Thanksgiving fixins'... I guess they think that without the fixins', there'll be no dinner! No dinner No way! Time to defeat some battle-hardened Turkeys!
My trusty weapon did a fine job of ruffling those rowdy turkeys' feathers, and I obtained all of the ingredients for Mom and Dad. In return, they gave me my Allowance! I guess doing chores does pay off! I can take this to any of the Store Vendors in New Leaf City, and receive a Nexon Game Card for it! ...I'd better get out of here before Aunt Petunia shows up! Mom mentioned that I can help her with dinner once a day until it's time to eat!
quests.requirements: Corn x 1, Stuffing Scoop x 1, Cranberry Sauce x 1, Mashed Potato x 1, Gravy x 1

quests.name: Game On! <CVS>
quests.description:
I helped Mom and Dad with Thanksgiving dinner and received my Allowance! Now I can head to Henesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City and obtain a Nexon Game Card from one of the Vendors!
I have my Allowance, and I'm on my way to Henesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City! I just have to speak with one of the Vendors there to receive a Nexon Game Card! Just have to make sure I have some room in my ETC slot for it...
I spoke with one of the vendors, and in return for my Allowance, I received a Nexon Game Card! I can also take this to any of the Store Vendors in Henesys, Amoria, or New Leaf City if one store happens to be sold out. I can help Mom and Dad everyday until the end of the event, receive Allowance and get another Nexon Game Card. I should get as many as possible, because when the event ends, it will turn into MaplePoints that I can use in the Cash Shop! Free money! WOO HOO!
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Nexon Game Card - 100 points (95%), Nexon Game Card - 250 points (5%)

quests.name: Game On! <Rite Aid>
quests.description:
I helped Mom and Dad with Thanksgiving dinner and received my Allowance! Now I can head to Henesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City and obtain a Nexon Game Card from one of the Vendors!
I have my Allowance, and I'm on my way to Henesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City! I just have to speak with one of the Vendors there to receive a Nexon Game Card! Just have to make sure I have some room in my ETC slot for it...
I spoke with one of the vendors, and in return for my Allowance, I received a Nexon Game Card! I can also take this to any of the Store Vendors in Henesys, Amoria, or New Leaf City if one store happens to be sold out. I can help Mom and Dad everyday until the end of the event, receive Allowance and get another Nexon Game Card. I should get as many as possible, because when the event ends, it will turn into MaplePoints that I can use in the Cash Shop! Free money! WOO HOO!

quests.name: Little Suzy's X-Mas Dilemma
quests.description:
There's a little girl with a puzzled look on her face in New Leaf City. With X-mas time just around the corner, she should be happy... I wonder why she looks so puzzled and confused instead Looks like she may need some help with her Maplemas spirit!
Little Suzy was all excited for Maplemas this year... until she learned all about a similar holiday called "Versalmas" from a strange green mouse named O-Pongo. Now she doesn't know what sounds more exciting - Maplemas... or Versalmas Suzy needs my help to help her decide which version of X-mas she should celebrate this year. In order to do that, I'll have to speak to both Maple Claws and this O-Pongo character, and then come back and talk to her. Maplemas holiday from an alternate dimension, huh Very curious...
I spoke to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo. It seems that both Maplemas and Versalmas have their merits. In the end, Suzy's put the decision on me: she's asked me to deliver her X-mas Wishlist to one of the two "Santas," which will determine which holiday she's celebrating this year. I have a feeling that this decision is important, that I'm not just making a choice for her... but also one for myself. Which holiday do I believe in

quests.name: The Spirit of Maplemas
quests.description:
To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to Maple Claws. I'm sure she's back in town now in Happyville.
To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to Maple Claws about Suzy's dilemma. Maple Claws listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy. I should talk to her in a bit.
Maple Claws gave me a message for Suzy: that as long as she remembers the essence of the Maplemas Spirit, it doesn't really matter what holiday traditions she chooses to follow this year. I should return to Suzy with Maple Claws' message once I've also spoken to O-Pongo.

quests.name: A Versal Tradition
quests.description:
To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to O-Pongo. I'd better speak with this strange green mouse and find out more details about Versalmas.
To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to O-Pongo about Suzy's dilemma. O-Pongo listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy. I should talk to her in a bit.
Versal Power! I spoke with O-Pongo, the Versalmas Mouse, who is the "Santa" for the Versal version of Maplemas, and learned a great deal about Versalmas. He told me about the customs for their holiday--quite different from the Maple World! The world of Versal is usually shrouded in darkness; Versalmas is an annual holiday that celebrates the emergence of the sun in their world, which shines for 90 straight days and only for these 90 days. For Versalmas, children receive presents every day for the first 30 days, and get cool treats like Sugar-coated Olives and Caramel Onions! Sounds pretty awesome... Now I'd better speak with Maple Claws and head back to Suzy... It makes me wonder for myself though, which holiday would I pick to celebrate Hmmm...

quests.name: A Very Merry Maplemas
quests.description:
Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo. I'm thinking I should give it to Maple Claws; I should go see her in Happyville.
I can give Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws. In doing so, she'll be counting on me to help me recover her presents for her this year. All I have to do now is to give Maple Claws the list to cement my decision. Yes... it's going to be a very Merry Maplemas this year!
I thought that Maplemas was the better holiday so I gave Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws. In return, she gave me a red Maplemas Hat that I can wear proudly to show my Maplemas Spirit! Every time I help Maple Claws recover the presents stolen by monsters, she'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents with her in batches of 10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100. I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards! I'll need to bring her presents appropriate to my level though. Bringing Maple Claws more presents will also help me earn Maplemas Spirit! If the total amount of Maplemas Spirit accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of Versalmas Cheer, Maple Claws will have a special something for me at the end of the event!a

quests.name: Happy Versalmas to You
quests.description:
Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo. I should go see O-Pongo in New Leaf City if I want to give it to him. Decisions, decisions...
I'm thinking it's Versalmas for me this year! All I have to do now to cement my decision is to actually give Little Suzy's Wishlist to O-Pongo. I can't wait! It's time for a change of pace!
Looks like I'm celebrating Versalmas this year! I gave Little Suzy's Wishlist to O-Pongo, and he gave me this awesome Versalmas Hat for me to wear proudly! Every time I bring O-Pongo presents I've collected from monsters, he'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents to him in batches of 10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100. I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards! I'll need to bring him presents appropriate to my level though. Bringing O-Pongo more presents will also help me earn Versalmas Cheer! If the total amount of Versalmas Cheer accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of Maplemas Spirit, O-Pongo will have something really nice for me at the end of the event!

quests.name: Elpam's Gift
quests.description:
Looks like Elpam is celebrating a new holiday. I should head over to New Leaf City and check it out!
Elpam is celebrating the holiday known as Versalmas! He'd like me to speak with O-Pongo, the Versalmas Mouse, and the one who gives presents. Looks like Elpam has received his gift from O-Pongo, who is also in New Leaf City, so doing this shouldn't be too tough...
Elpam offered me a slab of Melting Cheese as a Versalmas gift! Er, a strange gift but I gladly accepted this as a token of friendship! He also said that I should speak with O-Pongo to learn more about this Versal tradition...

quests.name: Giant Swowman's Purple box
quests.description:
Bill is frantically looking for a Purple box. I wonder why...
If I find the Purple box for Bill, she promised to open the box for me. I wonder what's inside that box...
Bill was gracious enough to open the Purple box for me. It also felt good to contribute 50 mesos towards kids that are less fortunate in MapleStory.

quests.name: The Wandering Alchemist Eurek's New Skill
quests.description:
I hear that Eurek the Alchemist over in Sleepywood is working on a way to scroll items without equipping them. I should go see Eurek and see how far along his research is--maybe I can learn how to do it!
I spoke with Eurek and he's perfected his method for scrolling unequipped items. I've agreed to gather some materials for him for a trip he's taking. I'll need to get Eurek the Alchemist everything he needs: Red Whip 1302013/1 Scroll for One-Handed Sword for ATT 2043000/1 Scroll for Helmet for DEF 2040000/1 Scroll for Topwear for DEF 2040400/1 Scroll for Bottomwear for DEF 2040600/1 1,000,000 mesos. I can't wait for him to show me how to perform this new skill!
I returned with the materials that Eurek the Alchemist asked for and learned how to use scrolls on unequipped items! Eurek also mentioned that in his travels, he'd heard rumors of a powerful monster residing somewhere in Leafre--even stronger than Zakum.
