quests.name: Monster Riding
quests.description:
The keeper of the Aquarium, Kenta, is researching a way to tame and possibly ride monsters. I should take a trip to Aqua Road and see if there's anything I can do to help!
Kenta found out that someone is trying to steal his research. Kenta asked me to watch the wild boar and bring back Kenta's Report to him. On top of that, he asked me to get the wild boar's Pheromone as well...I'd better stay alert for this one--I don't want someone to steal his research before I learn how to tame and ride monsters! Kenta's ReportKenta's Report 4031508/5 PheromonePheromone 4031507/5.
I obtained the items and returned to the Aquarium. For helping him with his research, Kenta gave me the monster riding skill and one Saddle for the monster. It's time to travel in style! I must look in the Tiger Ridge map, there should be some rubble lying about--a hidden portal. Traveling through it will transport me to a new area with the pigs. I can use the perfume when I'm close to one to capture it. After that, I can equip the Mount and the saddle, and use my new Monster Riding skill to call the mount! I can feed my pet by visiting the Leafre Pet Food Seller, and make it stronger. Hmm...I wonder if there's a way to get a stronger mount I'd have to be ready for the 4th Job advancement, I'll bet..

quests.name: Pheromone Perfume
quests.description:
0 = Kenta is performing further research about monster riding. I wonder if he's finished researching Pheromone Time to grab my swimming trunks and head back to Aqua Road!
Kenta said that he not only did more research on Pheromone, he's discovered a way to make it work! However, he'll need a special perfume from Chief Tatamo from Leafre Village to make Pheromone Perfume which trains the monster. Leafre is in Ossyria, so I've got a bit of a journey on my hands... Dragon's Perfume BottleDragon's Perfume Bottle 4031509/1.
After a long journey to Leafre, I traveled back to the Aquarium with the perfume in hand and gave it to Kenta. He believes that this method should work and gave me Pheromone Perfume for the monster. He told me that if I take it somewhere in the next town# I would be able to train wild boars!

quests.name: Lost Saddle
quests.description:
I lost the Saddle that I received from Kenta! What should I do Hmmm... maybe I should go see Kenta. I hope he's nice enough to give me another one!
Kenta says that making a Saddle for monster riding requires special ingredients. He needs 200Tiger Skin, 200 Dragon Skin, 200 Dark Jr. Yeti Skin. Kenta says he will also need 5 million mesos for "research purposes". I believe this is otherwise known as "extortion". He's probably a bit upset at me for losing the first one. Oh well, looks like I've got some work to do... Tiger SkinTiger Skin 4000171/200#
I returned to Kenta with the proper materials and the 5 million meso extortion--I mean "Research Fee". In return for my efforts, I received Saddle from Kenta. I should be able ride monsters again with this. I'll be sure not to lose it again!
quests.requirements: Dragon Skin x 200, Dark Jr. Yeti Skin x 200, Tiger Skin x 200

quests.name: Lost Perfume
quests.description:
I lost Pheromone Perfume. I can't train the monster without it. What should I do I should head back to Aqua Road and go see Kenta. Maybe I can tell him that I met someone in Amoria and had to go on a date...
Kenta says he's heard of this phenomena of people using that perfume on dates. He doesn't understand why, it smells a lot like raw garlic and hot feet to him. Luckily, he has plenty of Pheromone and he will make me another Pheromone Perfume if I bring him Dragon's Perfume Bottle. Dragon's Perfume BottleDragon's Perfume Bottle 4031509/1. I'd better hurry back--I want my new mount!
I recieved Pheromone Perfume from Kenta. Phew...I should go train my monster now. On the way, I'll think of a better excuse if I lose the perfume again--this kinda does smell like hot feet...

quests.name: Silver Mane
quests.description:
I've heard that Kenta has furthered his research and found a way to upgrade my existing mount. A faster monster to ride I should go see Kenta in Aqua Road immediately!
I visited the Aquarium and Kenta has indeed found a way to make the mounts bigger, faster and stronger! However, he needs Rexton Leather, Wooden Shoulder Pad, and Skull Shoulder Pad to make the experiement a success. He asked for a "donation" of 50 million mesos to develop the technology for monster and human to co-exist. That's some expensive research! He must be raking it in... Rexton LeatherRexton Leather 4000264/600 Wooden Shoulder PadWooden Shoulder Pad 4000266/400 Skull Shoulder PadSkull Shoulder Pad 4000267/400
It took a bit of time, but I returned with the needed items and "donation" he asked for. Kenta made my Hog into a Silver Mane. What a difference! My mount is so much sharper and stronger than before! I can run over almost anything now!
quests.requirements: Hog x 1, Rexton Leather x 600, Wooden Shoulder Pad x 400, Skull Shoulder Pad x 400

quests.name: Dragon's Perfume Bottle
quests.description:
It's time to take my mount to another level! Let's go see Chief Tatamo in Leafre and see if he has any methods to improve my mount!
After reaching Leafre, I spoke with Chief Tatamo. He confirmed that he does have a way to improve my mount--by turning it into a powerful dragon! However, like most good things in life, this is not free. He's agreed to sell me the dragon's perfume for the low, discounted price of 20 million meso because it is rare. Really rare. So rare, in fact, that he still has his original stockpile. At 20 Million mesos per, I'm not surprised...
After thinking it over, I gave Chief Tatamo 20 million mesos and got the dragon's perfume. I took a whiff, it smells like candy, chocolate, and roses...I'm tempted to drink it! However, I want an awesome dragon mount, so I'll have to pass. I can't wait to ride it!

quests.name: 드래곤 라이더
quests.description:
메이플 월드의 누구보다도 강한 사람. 더 이상 오를 곳이 없는 경지에 다다른 사람. 그것은 바로 당신이다. 200 레벨을 달성한 당신을 위해, 모든 전사들의 사제 Harmonia가 준비한 것이 있다고 한다.
정신과 육체를 극한까지 단련한 수많은 전사들이 갖길 원했지만, 누구의 소유도 되지 않았던 Red Draco를 소개해 주겠다는 Harmonia... 메이플 월드에서 가장 강한 자만이 그와 친구가 될 수 있다고 하는데...
더 이상 올라갈 곳이 없는 지고의 경지에서 새로운 친구를 얻었다.

quests.name: 드래곤 라이더
quests.description:
메이플 월드의 누구보다도 강한 사람. 더 이상 오를 곳이 없는 경지에 다다른 사람. 그것은 바로 당신이다. 200 레벨을 달성한 당신을 위해, 모든 마법사들의 사제 Gritto가 준비한 것이 있다고 한다.
궁극의 마력을 지닌 수많은 마법사들이 갖길 원했지만, 누구의 소유도 되지 않았던 Red Draco를 소개해 주겠다는 Gritto... 메이플 월드에서 가장 강한 자만이 그와 친구가 될 수 있다고 하는데...
더 이상 올라갈 곳이 없는 지고의 경지에서 새로운 친구를 얻었다.

quests.name: 드래곤 라이더
quests.description:
메이플 월드의 누구보다도 강한 사람. 더 이상 오를 곳이 없는 경지에 다다른 사람. 그것은 바로 당신이다. 200 레벨을 달성한 당신을 위해, 모든 궁수들의 사제 Legor가 준비한 것이 있다고 한다.
극을 꿰뚫는 활을 가진 수많은 궁수들이 갖길 원했지만, 누구의 소유도 되지 않았던 Red Draco를 소개해 주겠다는 Gritto... 메이플 월드에서 가장 강한 자만이 그와 친구가 될 수 있다고 하는데...
더 이상 올라갈 곳이 없는 지고의 경지에서 새로운 친구를 얻었다.

quests.name: 드래곤 라이더
quests.description:
메이플 월드의 누구보다도 강한 사람. 더 이상 오를 곳이 없는 경지에 다다른 사람. 그것은 바로 당신이다. 200 레벨을 달성한 당신을 위해, 모든 도적들의 사제 Hellin이 준비한 것이 있다고 한다.
어둠 속에서 세상을 지배하는 수많은 도적들이 갖길 원했지만, 누구의 소유도 되지 않았던 Red Draco를 소개해 주겠다는 Gritto... 메이플 월드에서 가장 강한 자만이 그와 친구가 될 수 있다고 하는데...
더 이상 올라갈 곳이 없는 지고의 경지에서 새로운 친구를 얻었다.

quests.name: The Book of Invisible Ink
quests.description:
I found a mysterious book deep in the Aquarium sea while exploring. It is Bowman-related and mentions mastery of a skill known as Eye of the Heart. There's also a fading inscription about obtaining something from the book itself. Could this be a skillbook I must find out! Wiz the Librarian knows a lot about books. I should ask if he can decipher anything useful from this book...
Wiz the Librarian read the book and speculated that the book must've been written with invisible ink to conceal valuable information. Clever...but not impossible to break. He says I have to get a special type of ink in order to read it. He can use the ink to restore the inscriptions so it is once again readable. The ingredients are Ink Bottle, Pure Water, and The Magic Rock...I hope this isn't all for naught... Ink BottleInk Bottle 4000183 / 50 Pure WaterPure Water 2022000 / 10 The Magic RockThe Magic Rock 4006000 / 30 [Storybook] Ancient Book[Storybook] Ancient Book 4161018 / 1.
I found the ingridients and returned them to Wiz the Librarian. He said making the ink takes a bit of time, so I'll have to wait until it's ready.
quests.requirements: Pure Water x 10, The Magic Rock x 30, Ink Bottle x 50, [Storybook] Ancient Book x 1

quests.name: The Ancient Book
quests.description:
After I handed him all the ingredients, Wiz the Librarian sprinkled the ink on the book. Before our eyes, the ink soaked into the pages and restored the words! It revealed information about the bowman's ultimate skill! What could that be It sounds powerful...I should go ask Athena Pierce. Bowman's Way 4161024 / 1.
When I asked Athena Pierce about the book, she was shocked! I related the entire tale of the ink restoring the pages, and how Wiz the Librarian mentioned it was made with invisible ink to prevent knowledge of this technique from spreading into unworthy hands. She has agreed to take a further look into the book to find out more.

quests.name: The Bowman's Ultimate Skill
quests.description:
While studying the book, Athena remarked that she's heard about the Bowman's Ultimate Skill but has never seen one of these books before. She told me that if one masters this skill, they might even surpass her in level. To discover more, she told me to go see Rene... Road of Bowman 4161025 / 1 for more information. This is shaping up to be quite a journey...
I traveled to the frozen fields of El Nath and gave the book to Rene. She was intrigued by the book as well, and wants to study it a bit more before she tells me more information.

quests.name: Shammos's Advice
quests.description:
Despite her vast knowledge of bow-based combat, Rene, like Athena Pierce, didn't know much about the skill. I hear Shammos's rambling about something...Perhaps I should pay him a visit... Road of Bowman 4161026 / 1
Shammos took the book and started reading it. Would he know something He certainly appeared focused on deciphering what this new skill could be...I hope he can tell me more!

quests.name: New Guess
quests.description:
My hunch was right about Shammos. He knew a bit more and was able to give me further details, but there's something strange about what Shammos said. Let's ask Rene. Finally getting somewhere! Road of Bowman 4161027 / 1
I took the book back to Rene following a lead from Shammos. Rene said that Shammos used to be human and that I should pay close attention to what he says--both as a warning and path to discovering more.

quests.name: The One Who Remembers...
quests.description:
I spoke with Rene, who had a new suggestion to help me piece together this puzzle. She told me to go to see The Rememberer in Sleepywood. I can sense the answers coming soon--they'd better, because my feet are tiring from all this walking! Road of Bowman 4161028 / 1
My journey continues...The Rememberer had no idea about the book. But he said he might be able to point me in the right direction to who would know about the book...

quests.name: Insignificant Being
quests.description:
The Rememberer said Insignificant Being will know about the Bowman's ultimate skill. At last! I'm on my way there now! Road of Bowman 4161029 / 1
Insignificant Being was aware of the book and gave me the answers I needed. I see that my journey has just begun, but I will gain tremendous power should I see it through to completion. Onward!

quests.name: Spiritual Stone of Darkness
quests.description:
Insignificant Being says he can send me to the Bowman's training place if I bring him Dark Soul Rock which is carried by Another World : Practice Field. Dark Soul RockDark Soul Rock 4031466 / 50
I gave 50 Dark Soul Rock, which is needed to enter Another World : Practice Field, to Insignificant Being. I am one step closer to obtaining this ultimate skill. The anticipation is growing within me...

quests.name: Junior Balrog in a Different World
quests.description:
Insignificant Being said he'll teach me the ultimate skill once I go to Another World : Practice Field and get 300 Jr. Balrog in Another World. It's almost within my grasp! Jr. Balrog in Another World 61081#
After completing the training to catch Junior Balrogs in Another World : Practice Field, I acquired the Bowman's ultimate skill! Power is now mine--I shall master this skill and use it triumph over my enemies in battle!
quests.requirements: Defeat Jr. Balrog in Another World x 300

requirements_list.name: Jr. Balrog in Another World
requirements_list.label: Defeat Jr. Balrog in Another World x 300

quests.name: Manji's Test
quests.description:
I obtained a book I can't read. It looks like it's written in a strange language. The writing is crude, almost like an animal wrote it...a kind of monster language. I wonder if Manji would know how to read it. Couldn't hurt to speak with him...
My hunch paid off. When I asked Manji about the book, he examined the language closer and came to a conclusion. He said the book is about the Rush skill. He offered to translate, but he said that I must prove myself as one worthy to obtain such power--a true warrior in his eyes. I must eliminate 200 The Charging Taurospear in Secret Shrine located at the entrance of the Sanctuary, deep in Sleepywood. Manji saw that I was surprised by the high number and advised me to make a party with a few of like-minded companions to ensure victory. This is precisely what friends are for... The Charging Taurospear 61101#
With a bit of help from my trusty weapon, I easily defeated the requisite number that Manji requested. As promised, he translated the book, and it revealed the famed skill known as Rush. I can't wait to try it out!

quests.name: The Dragon's Guardian
quests.description:
Raul the Knight, guardian of the holy dragon Nine Spirit. I heard he knows a lot about dragons.
I met Raul, who introduced himself as the knight who guards the holy dragon, Nine Spirit. He needs help making the dragon grow and I've agreed to assist him. He told me to get Dragon Heart in order to make the baby dragon display it's potential power. Dragon Heart can only be obtained from a living dragon....If I catch a Wyvern, I'm sure I can get it. Dragon HeartDragon Heart 4031449/20
After a bit of Wyvern hunting, I brought Dragon Heart, Raul breathed power to the baby dragon. Now the baby dragon has 2321003#'s power!

quests.name: Bahamut's Power 1
quests.description:
After speaking with Raul the Knight, he said the dragon has not reached maturity. There must be something I can do to increase its' power...
Raul told me to gather 25 Dragon Heart if I want to raise 2321003#'s power. It's time to hunt! Dragon HeartDragon Heart 4031482/25
After I gave Raul Dragon Heart, he awakened 2321003#'s power. I can feel it radiating...magnificent!

quests.name: Bahamut's Power 2
quests.description:
I spoek with Raul the Knight, who mentioned that the dragon is not at its full power yet. I must find a way to increase its power further...perhaps through a ritual or item
Raul has agreed to help me further. He told me to gather 30 Dragon Heart if I want to raise 2321003#'s power. I should be able to strengthen the dragon even more! Dragon HeartDragon Heart 4031483/30
After a long hunt, I gave Raul Dragon Heart. Using it in an ancient ritual, he increased 2321003#'s power even more. Yet something tells me there is more power within the dragon, waiting to be unlocked...

quests.name: Bahamut's Power 3
quests.description:
The feeling I had within was confirmed by Raul the Knight. There is a way to unlock more of the dragon's power. I will not rest until I have discovered it. Raul has been helpful thus far--I wonder if he'd be willing to assist me again...
Raul has agreed to help me again. I'm to gather 35 Dragon Heart if I want to raise 2321003#'s power. Dragon HeartDragon Heart 4031484/35
Another long, but successful hunt. I gave Raul Dragon Heart, and he increased 2321003#'s power even more. When will the dragon reach its full power It seems to be limitless...

quests.name: Bahamut's Completion
quests.description:
I once again seek to enhance the power of the dragon. After speaking with Raul the Knight, he says the dragon still hasn't reached its full power. I must see this through to the end. The full power of the dragon must be a sight to behold. I must ask Raul for assistance once more to unleash the power of the dragon.
The final step to unlock the dragon's power is at hand! Raul says if I get 40Dragon Heart he will awaken 2321003#'s power. He says this will complete the dragon's power. My heart trembles with anticipation... Dragon HeartDragon Heart 4031485/40
At last, the dragon's power is complete. And it shall truly be a sight to behold! I will use this power wisely...

quests.name: Black Book
quests.description:
I obtained a peculiar looking book. The entire book, cover to cover, is black so I can't read it.... I'm getting a strange vibe from the book. Perhaps Gritto will know something about this book.
Gritto said to go see Carta, the witch from the deep sea, to get information about this book. Carta... Why won't Gritto just tell me about the book himself Would Carta really know anything I'm skeptical, but I have no choice...I must know more! [Storybook]Black book[Storybook]Black book 4001107 / 1
Carta didn't know much about the book itself. However, she seemed to know how to read the book. She understood the language, and agreed to tell me what it means upon my return.

quests.name: Method of Contradiction
quests.description:
I went to see Carta with [Storybook]Black book. Carta says I have to burn the book with cold flames in order to read it. A strange, but effective way of hiding the infromation contained within. The information has to be important if someone went through all this trouble. She's agreed to help me. I must gather 5 Charm of the Undead, 50Firebomb Flame, and 100Ice Piece to make Cold Flame which is needed to burn cold flames. Can I trust this witch I hope she does not lead me down the wrong path... Charm of the UndeadCharm of the Undead 4000008/5 Firebomb FlameFirebomb Flame 4000081/50 Ice PieceIce Piece 4000150/100
Success! I gave all the ingredients to Carta to make Cold Flame. Now, I must find a place to properly burn the book...perhaps the sea
quests.requirements: Ice Piece x 100, Charm of the Undead x 5, Firebomb Flame x 50

quests.name: Cold Flame
quests.description:
I found an altar within a deep sea cavern that was emitting cold energy. If I start a cold fire and throw in the black book, I should find out more about the content inside--but what to do after Perhaps taking the new book to Carta will yield answers. Caron's NoteCaron's Note 4161017 / 1
The book's identity has been revealed. It was Caron's Note! One journey ends as another begins...now to find out more!

quests.name: Caron's Note
quests.description:
According to Carta, the author of this book appears to be Caron, a boatman at the River of Death who takes spirits to the underworld. He wrote stories about ferrying those who died to the underworld; but yet returned, somehow brought back to life. As I continued to read, I noticed a familar name. It was The Rememberer of Sleepywood... Carta told me I could find out about the secrets of death if I meet those who returned from the grave. There is a secret here that I must discover!
The Rememberer knew about Caron as Carta said. It appears there is a way to learn how to bring back the dead back to life. Such a technique would certainly come in handy during encounters with dangerous monsters. I must learn it!

quests.name: Resurrection
quests.description:
When I asked The Rememberer to teach me how to resurrect the dead, he told me that I have to experience death. He told me to go to the dark place across from the Door of death, guarded by Thanatos, at the Bottom of Ludibrium clock tower. I'm a bit scared, but my spirit is telling me that this is the path to take. Deathly FearDeathly Fear 4031448/1
That was a tough test, but somehow, I survived. I received the supremely powerful skill known as 2321006#. The Rememberer said those who obtain such power should never abuse it. This technique, while powerful, breaks one of nature's most sacred laws, that of life and death. I should be careful...

quests.name: Return of the Dark Lord
quests.parent: The one hidden in the shadow
quests.description:
Hellin says he has something to tell me...perhaps I should pay him a visit.
Hellin told me to meet Dark Lord. Now that I think about it, it's been a long time since I've seen the Dark Lord. He never seems to age...
Dark Lord said he has some interesting suggestions and that if I'm interested, he'll tell me more.

quests.name: The Night Warrior
quests.parent: The one hidden in the shadow
quests.description:
Dark Lord says he has a good suggestion and has offered to tell me more. Perhaps I should accept. I've heard it is unwise to refuse a request from the Dark Lord.
Dark Lord said he wanted me to be his disciple and has entrusted me with disciplining his other students. He told me to defeat his other 6 disciples who are disguised as him and earn their loyalty. He told me if I'm interested to come back to him and ask I want to know about being a Thief...Is this some sort of game The Dark Lord is known for his wily tricks and deceitful ways, but also for great power...I will see where this path leads me, hopefully to a new skill! Dark Lord's Disciple 61411#
I defeated the imposters and earned their loyalty. I made Dark Lord's Disciple, a powerful Thief, into my shadow partner. I can now use him and the other five students in battle to great effect. My enemies will never know what hit them...

quests.name: The Great Warrior, Sayram
quests.description:
Wiz the Librarian of Helios Tower <Library> says he has something to tell me...
Wiz the Librarian talked about a warrior named Seram. He mentioned a singing shield which I can use to get information about the old techniques of Sayram. Then he told me to go see Chief Tatamo at Leafle to find more information about him...Let's go see Leafre's Chief with the Sayram's Journey that Wiz the Librarian gave me. Should be an amusing trip at the least. A singing shield I wonder... Sayram's JourneySayram's Journey 4161019 / 1
Tatamo seems to know about Sayram, however, the singing shield is another matter. I wonder if this is all true or just some kind of joke...perhaps I should talk with Chief Tatamo again.

quests.name: Griffey's Necklace
quests.description:
Chief Tatamo knows about Sayram but doesn't know anything about the singing shield. He says that I might be able to find some information on it from the Sayram's Necklace which Sayram gave to Griffey, whom he dearly loved. So I'll head to Minar Forest and find the necklace from the Griffey. Should be a piece of cake...yea, right... Sayram's NecklaceSayram's Necklace 4031479/1
I found Sayram's Necklace, and after some "persuasion", obtained the necklace. Now to return to Chief Tatamo and see what he says about this.

quests.name: Singing Shield
quests.description:
I brought the necklace back to Tatamo, the chief of Leafre. He looked at the picture inscribed on the Griffey's necklace, and said that since Insignificant Being knows about Sayram, I should go show him the necklace. Off I go! Sayram's NecklaceSayram's Necklace 4031467/1
On Chief Tatamo's recommendation, I spoke with Insignificant Being, who knew about the necklace and the Singing Shield. I must ask him for more information about the shield!

quests.name: Sayram's Skill
quests.description:
Insignificant Being said the picture on the necklace points to Forgotten Shrine, the deepest part in the entrance of the Shrine. He said that I would find the Singing Shield there. However, he said Forgotten Shrine would be locked so I would have to eliminate Jr. Balrog to get the key....Will I really get Sayram's shield there The Insignificant Being tells me to try taking the key I already used for another world to Wiz the Librarian as well...This is getting interesting, I'd better keep my weapon close! Sayram's ShieldSayram's Shield 4031471/1 Key to the Forgotten ShrineKey to the Forgotten Shrine 4031475/1
I went to Wiz the Librarian of Helios Tower <Library> to find the singing shield. While talking to the Wiz, Wiz found the skill book from the singing shield. This WAS the great warrior Sayram's skill! I have learned a new technique! Quite unexpected but excellent nonetheless. I shall use this in battle to defeat my enemies!
quests.requirements: Key to the Forgotten Shrine x 1, Sayram's Shield x 1

requirements_list.name: Key to the Forgotten Shrine
requirements_list.label: Key to the Forgotten Shrine x 1

quests.name: Robeira's Book
quests.description:
Robeira says she has something he wants to tell me...perhaps I should pay him a visit and see what could be so important.
Robeira said she has a book she really wants to show me and told me to see Wiz the Librarian in the Helios Tower. I wonder why she dropped off the book there Maybe the information is meant to kept secret...
Wiz the Librarian agreed to find the book for me. I wonder what the book says, must be important...

quests.name: A Magician's Story
quests.description:
Wiz the Librarian said the book Robeira left for me is quite strange, and relates to Magicians somehow. I'm supposed to deliver it to Grendel the Really Old if I'm finished with it. Magician's story What could it be Maybe I can ask Grendel the Really Old. Story of a Magician 4161020 / 1
Upon delivering the book to Grendel the Really Old, I decided to ask about the book. My words met with a empty look and eerie silence. I may have just hit a nerve...

quests.name: Another Crazy Genius?!
quests.description:
After an uneasy silence, Grendel the Really Old spoke at last. He said that the main character of the book is none other than Shammos, who used to be a human and a genius Magician. Then he asked me to go check out the elder's official residence, Shammos, to see how he's doing these days...
Shammos is still out of it. But I think I heard him say Grendel the Really Old ..

quests.name: Shammos!
quests.description:
When I asked Shammos about Grendel the Really Old, I could tell he was very resentful towards Grendel the Really Old and Robeira. Let's go back to Grendel the Really Old and tell him about Shammos.
Grendel the Really Old looked disappointed as he said how Shammos used to be a great Magician...

quests.name: Grendel the Really Old's Apology
quests.description:
Shammos seems very resentful. Grendel the Really Old asked me to tell him that he's sorry. But would Shammos even accept his apology Either way, let's go to Shammos and relay Grendel the Really Old's message.
Shammos just kept shouting Robeira and Grendel the Really Old's name. I wonder if he's really crazy...

quests.name: Robeira's Intentions
quests.description:
Shammos seemed exhausted and mumbled Robeira to forgive him. Let's go to see Robeira.
Robeira said there's no way he can let Shammos go...

quests.name: Robeira and Shammos
quests.description:
Shammos became quiet for some reason. What's the matter Let's go talk to Shammos.
Shammos seems to have regained consciousness.

quests.name: Meteo Shower
quests.description:
Shammos might be feeling a little better...I should pay him a visit...
As I approached Shammos to check if he's okay, he seemed to be more alert, as if part of his memory returned. He told me to bring him Eye of Fire... Let's go see the guard of the Abandoned Mine, Adobis, Eye of FireEye of Fire 4001017 / 1
I learned a new magic spell! This is the magic that Shammos studied...it's powerful magic that I will use to emerge victorious in battle!

quests.name: Blizzard
quests.description:
I wonder if Shammos's is feeling better. I should pay him a visit...
As I approached Shammos to check if he's okay, he seemed to be more alert, as if part of his memory returned. He told me to bring him Cold Heart of a Wolf...Let's go see Lycanthrope. Cold Heart of a WolfCold Heart of a Wolf 4031460 / 1
I learned a new magic spell! This is the magic that Shammos studied...it's powerful magic that I will use to emerge victorious in battle!
quests.requirements: Cold Heart of a Wolf x 1

requirements_list.name: Cold Heart of a Wolf
requirements_list.label: Cold Heart of a Wolf x 1

quests.name: Genesis
quests.description:
I wonder if Shammos's is feeling up to a conversation...I should pay him a visit...
As I approached Shammos to check if he's okay, he seemed to be more alert, as if part of his memory returned. He told me to bring him Life Roots... Let's go to the Cave of Life. Life RootsLife Roots 4031461 / 1
I learned a new magic spell! This is the magic that Shammos studied...it's powerful magic that I will use to emerge victorious in battle!

quests.name: A Shield's True Power
quests.description:
I heard there's a Moose in Leafre Forest that really loves shields!
Moose gets upset at those who think the shield is weak. He developed a new shield skill and said to get used to fighting with the shield if I want to learn the new skill. He told me to hunt 200 Black Kentaurus at the training ground he prepared... Black Kentaurus 61801#
After I got 200 Black Kentaurus, Moose taught me the skill known as Guardian!

quests.name: The Plot to Kidnap Tylus!
quests.description:
I was attacked by Crimson Balrog while on the plane to Orbis. After protecting the passengers from Crimson Balrog and defeating him, I obtained a strange document. It was a conspiracy to kidnap Tylus, the elder of warriors in El Nath. I'm worried. Let's go discuss it with Harmonia.
Harmonia said that I only found half of the document. He advised me to take the half sheet and go see Spiruna to find the missing part. [Storybook] Crimson Balrog's Proposal 4001111 / 1
I told Spiruna about the conspiracy to kidnap Tylus . He's thinking of a way to stop it...

quests.name: Spiruna's advice
quests.description:
Spiruna looked in the crystal ball and told me that Lycanthrope has the other half of the kidnapping plan, masterminded by Tylus. Lycanthrope That means Crimson Balrog and Lycanthrope conspired together Let's get the note that Lycanthrope has and go back to Harmonia. Lycanthrope's PlansLycanthrope's Plans 4031477 / 1
I went to Harmonia with the rest of the paper that I got from Lycanthrope. Harmonia asked me to immediately go and protect Tylus. I'm on my way...

quests.name: Protecting Tylus
quests.description:
Tylus said he heard the news from Harmonia, and accepted my protection. I have to protect Tylus and receive Tylus's Trust. Let's go see Tylus again after successfully protecting Tylus. Tylus's TrustTylus's Trust 4031495 / 1
I successfully protected Tylus from Crimson Balrog and Lycanthrope. Tylus taught me the Power Stance skill.

quests.name: A Peculiar Request
quests.description:
A request came in from Arec. A request from him Must be because of my last job...
Arec said it had to do with finding an item. He didn't tell me what it is or why he needs it.... Since it's coming from Arec I guess I'll just do it but I wonder what this is all about Anyway, let's go to Shawn at the Excavation Site.
Shawn seemed very anxious. What exactly does he want I should press on, maybe I'll find out...

quests.name: Shawn's  fear
quests.description:
I was told to bring requested object from an unrevealed relic. A newly discovered relic...What could it possibly be Shawn's RequestShawn's Request 4031452/1
...I brought the requested object. It wasn't easy but I did it. Shawn looked extremely happy, but a bit worried at the same time. What could be bothering him

quests.name: Arec and Shadower
quests.description:
Shawn said he is thankful to have me because this job is very dangerous and it hasn't gone through the appropriate approval process. A dangerous task that hasn't gone through the approval process...should he be asking me to do this I wonder...let's go see Arec.
In return for the job...I received the Assassinate skill. This will definitely come in handy...

quests.name: Black Clouds...
quests.description:
I got a book called "How to make black clouds" in Orbis. Isn't this Hugh's book I should return it.
Hugh said it's not his book. However, he told me that it has information on how to make something amazing. Hugh said he'll make it and asked me to bring him the ingredients....I have to see Kay and Porter to get some of the ingredients. This is going to take some time. Ventilating Fan Ventilating Fan 4031462 / 1 Dual Pirate's PropellerDual Pirate's Propeller 4000133 / 10 ScrewScrew 4003000 / 50 Ink BottleInk Bottle 4000183 / 100 Steel PlateSteel Plate 4011001 / 20 CogCog 4000115 / 50 Long-lasting BatteryLong-lasting Battery 4031478 / 1
Hugh completed the black cloud maker!
quests.requirements: Dual Pirate's Propeller x 10, Screw x 50, Ink Bottle x 100, Steel Plate x 20, Ventilating Fan x 1, Cog x 50, Long-lasting Battery x 1

quests.name: Building a Ventilation Fan
quests.description:
If I need Ventilating Fan, I should go see Kay in Omega Sector.
Among the ingredients for Black Cloud Machine that Hughes the Fuse gave me, I came here because I was told to ask bKay for Ventilating Fan....but Kay says he's also busy and wants me to get ingredients: He needs 100 Propeller and 1 Steel Plate. Sure is a lot of stuff... PropellerPropeller 4000103 / 100 Steel PlateSteel Plate 4011001 / 1
I gave Propeller and Steel Plate and got Ventilating Fan. One step closer to the end...

quests.name: Porter's Durable Battery
quests.description:
If I need Long-lasting Battery, I should go see Porter in Porter inOmega Sector.
Hughes the Fuse said he left Long-lasting Battery with Porter and told me to get it from him. But Porter says that he doesn't remember anything about Long-lasting Battery but he might if I bring him Papulatus Certificate. ...He's cunning, I certianly wouldn't guessed that by looking at him. Papulatus CertificatePapulatus Certificate 4001084 / 1
I gave him Papulatus Certificate and received Long-lasting Battery. At last!

quests.name: The End of Attributes...?
quests.description:
I have reached the highest level of the elemental attributes. Is there a stronger attribute magic that I can learn Let's go ask Alcaster.
Alcaster mentioned about inverse attributes, and suggested that we research it. He wants me to bring him the ingredients for the research.... Frozen Shark's FinFrozen Shark's Fin 4000181/30 Ice PieceIce Piece 4000150/40 Ice BackboneIce Backbone 4000185/30
I gathered all ingredients for the inverse attributes. But does Alcaster know what he's doing
quests.requirements: Frozen Shark's Fin x 30, Ice Piece x 40, Ice Backbone x 30

quests.name: Inverse Attributes
quests.description:
Alcaster said he will conduct an experiment with the ingredients, and told me to come back to him in a little bit.
I tried the experiment with bAlcaster but unfortunately it failed. Alcaster told me to go to see Huckle, an expert on magic ingredients.
Huckle said the inverse attributes is a bunch of nonsense. Nevertheless, he seemed intrigued by it and told me to go see Hughes the Fuse, the mad scientist in Orbis.

quests.name: Theory on Inverse Attributes of Summoned Beings (Familiars)
quests.description:
Huckle suggested that I go see Hughes the Fuse, the mad scientist in Orbis Tower.
I followed Huckle's advice and went to see Hughes the Fuse. Hughes the Fuse said that it's an interesting theory and said that we should try it on a summoned-being--a familiar. He says to get him the ingredients.... I can find everything else, but I'll need to see Huckle for Soul Pouch Orihalcon PlateOrihalcon Plate 4011005/10 Adamantium PlateAdamantium Plate 4011003/5 Mithril PlateMithril Plate 4011002/5 Soul PouchSoul Pouch 4031468/1
Hughes the Fuse said it would take time to make Summoning Frame and told me to talk to him later. I will return in a little while to check on his progress
quests.requirements: Orihalcon Plate x 10, Soul Pouch x 1, Mithril Plate x 5, Adamantium Plate x 5

quests.name: The Summoned Being's Structure
quests.description:
Hughes the Fuse asked me to wait while he makes Summoning Frame.
Hughes the Fuse Now that he finished making Summoning Frame, Hughes the Fuse said his job was done. I'll have to go see Alcaster to learn how to give it magic power. Summoning FrameSummoning Frame 4031451 / 1
Alcaster asked me talk to him later while he works on how to give magical power to Summoning Frame. I'll check on his progress in a little while.

quests.name: Huckle's Spirit Pouch
quests.description:
Hughes the Fuse says that Huckle will know how to make the spirit's pouch. Huckle seems to be a real expert on magical ingredients.
Huckle told me that he would make Soul Pouch if I bring all ingredients to him. Free SpiritFree Spirit 04000144/50 Evil SpiritEvil Spirit 04000146/50 Binding BridleBinding Bridle 04000148/30 The Summoning RockThe Summoning Rock 04006001/30
After I gathered all the ingredients, Huckle made the spirit's pouch for me.
quests.requirements: Free Spirit x 50, The Summoning Rock x 30, Evil Spirit x 50, Binding Bridle x 30

quests.name: Switching Attributes
quests.description:
I completed making Summoning Frame but there's no use. I'll have to ask Alcaster to find out how to give magic powers to the summoned-being so it becomes my familiar.
As I showed him the completed summoned-being's frame Alcaster said all that's left is to get the Spiritual Stone, which will ignite its' power. He said I would be able to find the stone in another world and that Flo would know how to get there. Icy Soul RockIcy Soul Rock 4031470/1
Using Summoning Frame, I mastered 2121005#!

quests.name: Key to a Different World
quests.description:
Alcaster told me to see Flo in the passage of time of Ludibrium to get Icy Soul Rock.
Flo said Key to the Other World is behind one of the doors in the twisted corridor. However, he said he lost the key while being chased by the gate keeper.... Key to the Other WorldKey to the Other World 4031473/1
I returned the key back to Flo.
quests.requirements: Key to the Other World x 1

requirements_list.name: Key to the Other World
requirements_list.label: Key to the Other World x 1

quests.name: Maple marble
quests.description:
I received [Storybook] Unknown Letter in the basement of the Ludibrium Castle. A letter with no name. I wonder who sent it... Let's go to the Cloudy Balcony, maybe there'll be some answers there...
When I got to Cloud Balcony, I was forcifully transported to somewhere. The man there seemed like a familiar thief I had seen before. But I couldn't put my finger on who he has exactly....He just demanded me to bring him Maple Marble. Who is this guy Why is he telling me to do this I feel like I should go up to the rooftop of Guild Headquarters where I can get a maple marble.... Maple MarbleMaple Marble 04031456/1
Unknown Thief spoke of Hellin.

quests.name: Three winds
quests.description:
Unknown Thief knows Hellin... I wonder what he wants to say
Unknown Thief asked me to find three winds and go see Hellin. Griffey Wind. Thanatos's Black Tornado. Boogie's Cursed Whirlwind. There's nothing in here that's easy to get. He said he'll give me a skill....I wonder what Seeing that he mentions Hellin, I think he's one of Hellin's followers... Griffey WindGriffey Wind 04031457/1 Thanatos's Black TornadoThanatos's Black Tornado 04031458/1 Boogie's Cursed WhirlwindBoogie's Cursed Whirlwind 04031459/1
Hellin gave me a new skill, 4121008#! I must find a way to master this skill...
quests.requirements: Griffey Wind x 1, Thanatos's Black Tornado x 1, Boogie's Cursed Whirlwind x 1

quests.name: Flame Bird
quests.description:
Kumo says he heard an interesting story....
Kumo said he heard that someone spotted the legendary fire bird. He said the bird's nest might be in the volcanic cave and told me to go check it out. I heard Phoenix's Nest was spotted deep inside the Cave of Distress. I wonder where that is...let's go find out. Phoenix's EggPhoenix's Egg 4001113/1
Kumo said he will find out how to hatch the egg.

quests.name: Phoenix
quests.description:
Kumo said I'll have to take the egg to the highest nest in the sky to wake up Phoenix's Egg... Phoenix 62411#
I battled Phoenix after it hatched from the egg and I put him under my control.

quests.name: Frostprey
quests.description:
Yaku says he has an urgent request...
Yaku mentioned the legendary ice bird, Frostprey, and asked me to go beneath the ice valley in El Nath. Freezer's EggFreezer's Egg 4001114/1
Yaku said he will find out how to hatch the eggs...

quests.name: Frostprey
quests.description:
Yaku says he found a good place to hatch Freezer.
Yaku thinks the highest nest in the sky should be able to hatch it. Sounds good. Let's go there. Freezer 62431#
I can use the power of Frostprey now!

quests.name: The Bowman's Inner Eye
quests.description:
Let's go see my former trainer, Legor.
Legor told me about his past and suggested that I go see Athena Pierce to find his missing Helena's Old Gloves if I feel like I've reached a plateau in my training. He says Kentaurus should have the gloves.... Helena's Old GlovesHelena's Old Gloves 4031465/1
Athena Pierce remembered the gloves that he gave to a boy long time ago and taught me a new skill called Hurricane. It is a skill that allows me to shoot lightning fast and powerful arrows.

quests.description:

quests.name: The Book of Ice
quests.description:
I got a strange book that is frozen. It seems very unusual. Let's go ask Gritto.
When I asked Gritto about the book, she told me to go see Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia to find out more about it. Grendel the Really Old should know about this book since he/she knows a lot about magic. [Storybook] Frozen Book of Ice 4161016 / 1
Grendel the Really Old was astonished by the legend and decided to break the spell that was cast on the book.

quests.name: A Mysterious Sentence
quests.description:
So they say Grendel the Really Old is a magic book inscribed with ice and it contains powerful ice element magic. He/She said she's gonna break the spell on the book...
The book contains myterious writing that I can't understand. They say I need to go see Robeira, an elder in Ossyria who has studied magic for a long time... Frozen Book of Ice 4161023 / 1
Robeira explained about a magic called 2221003# and told me about a mysterious legend. According to her, she's not sure if this is a real magic book but if it's about 2221003# it's definitely worth a try.

quests.name: The Snow Mountain's Ice Stone
quests.description:
Robeira recognized the book right away.
Robeira told me to go see Jeff, the guardian of Snow Mountain in El Nath, if I want to get 2221003#. I know he's the guardian of Snow Mountain, but would he know such a thing
The guard by Snow Mountain, Jeff said it's nonsense to break the ice engraved ancient letters as it's protected by magic. 2221003# is too appealing to give up here. The blacksmith, Vogen, could make a hammer that can break the ice...

quests.name: The Ultimate Icepick
quests.description:
The guardian of Snow Mountain, Jeff told me that if I want to break the ancient ice stone, I would have to go see Vogen to make a hammer strong enough.
Bogen said that although he's not sure if it will break the ancient magic, it's worth a try and asked me to get him the ingredients to make the hammer. Vogen. The Ingredients are Ice Piece, Orihalcon Plate and Moon Rock. Ice PieceIce Piece 4000150/30 Orihalcon PlateOrihalcon Plate 4011005/2 Moon RockMoon Rock 4011007/1
With Vogen's I got the hammer that will break the ice stone. Alright, let's go to see Jeff. I'm excited!
quests.requirements: Orihalcon Plate x 2, Ice Piece x 30, Moon Rock x 1

quests.name: A Book of Fire
quests.description:
I obtained a book inscribed with fire. It seems unusual... Let's go ask Gritto.
When I asked Gritto, she told me to go see Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia to find out more about it. Grendel the Really Old should know about the book since he/she know a lot about magic. [Storybook] Frozen Book of Ice 4161016 / 1

quests.description:
Robeira recognized the book right away.
Robeira told me to go see Adobis, the guardian of the Abandoned Mine in El Nath, if I want to get 2121003#. He drinks lava I know he's the guardian of the Abandoned Mine, but would he really know such a thing
The guardian of Abandoned Mine, Adobis said it's impossible to drink lava. However, 2121003# is too appealing for me to give up now. He says that the blacksmith, Vogen, could make a container that can hold the lava...

quests.name: The Lava Mug
quests.description:
The guard of the Abandoned Mine, Adobis told me to go see Vogen if I want a container that can hold lava.
Vogen isn't sure if he can make a container that will hold lava but he says he'll try. He'll need Firebomb Flame, Diamond, and Star Rock. Firebomb FlameFirebomb Flame 4000081/30 DiamondDiamond 4021007/2 Star RockStar Rock 4021009/1
With help from Vogen, I was able to make a container that'll hold lava. Let's go back to the Abandoned Mine.

quests.description:
Harmonia says he has something to tell me...
Harmonia talked about holy power and told me to go to the statue in Orbis Tower. They say I can get this power if I get Holy Cup and place it inside Holy Water of Life and give it to Statue... I heard the explorer leader, Teng, knows about Holy Cup. I'll go see him first then go to the Cave of Life. Holy Water of LifeHoly Water of Life 4031455/1
Statue in Orbis Tower gave me holy power!

quests.description:
Harmonia told me to go see Taeng the Explorer if I want to know about Holy Cup's whereabouts.
Taeng the Explorer, the one I met in the deep sea said he'll give me Holy Cup, which he got during his exploration, if I get him 10 Shark Denture's Shark to produce exploration tools. Shark DentureShark Denture 4000180/10
I gave Taeng the Explorer 10 Shark's Shark Denture and received Holy Cup..

Harmonia said 1321007# has much power in it but it's asleep now. He told me to see Mr. Bouffon to wake up his power.

quests.name: Carta's sin
quests.description:
Chief Tatamo from Leafre villiage says he has some information for me...
I learned that Humans used to have strong will power to resist temptation, which prevented them from getting seduced by the monsters. But, witch Carta took away the people's will power and since then, humans have been falling into seduction. I wonder if this is really true. Let's go ask Carta.
Carta doesn't look too thrilled.

quests.name: A Piece of Will
quests.description:
When I asked Carta to give back the human's will power, she said she threw it away in the crack of a dimension. She said if I want it back, go to Warped Dimension and get it myself. She says Warped Dimension can be opened by Minature Pianus as many times as I want....As long as I have Minature Pianus, she said she would open the dimension. Arite, well, let's get Minature Pianus first then. Piece of CouragePiece of Courage 4031472/40
Carta said that the separated will power can't be simply absorbed back.

Carta said that the will power needs to be made into medicine for it to be absorbed back. However, she said she won't do it unless I bring her her Mithril Wristband. She says I can get it from Eurek the Alchemist.
Would Eurek the Alchemist know about Carta's bracelet

They say she bids the bowman success and gives a special gift.
Athena bid me success as a bowman and gave me an arrow as a gift.

quests.name: Goddess's Arrangement
quests.description:
The Goddess has prepared something special for you for winning countless battles and becoming the best in Maple World. Let's go to Orbis, the statue of the Goddess.
A voice rang out from the Goddess's statue. She said that since I've reached the highest level one man could reach....you'll need greater power for the rest of the world. When you're ready to take on that kind of challenge, come see me.

quests.name: Protect Ludibrium
quests.description:
A mysterious power appeared in Ludibrium, then suddenly disappeared. Chaos ensued. Now is the time to straighten up the screwed-up time of Ludibrium. I'll need to go see Mr. Bouffon, who's at the Path of Time under Ludibrium.
I met up with Mr. Bouffon at the Path of Time. I promised him to find a new source of energy that may replace the original Time Sphere, which had been the main source of powerfor Ludibrium.
I gathered up enough Tachions and gave them to Mr. Bouffon as a replacement for the Time Sphere. I think he can make a new source of power with Tachion.

quests.name: The Replacement Time Energy
quests.description:
The source of energy has been swallowed a whole by Papulatus Clock with the disappearance of the time sphere. I need Mr. Bouffon to find a way for an alternative.
Thanks to Papulatus Clock with Time Sphere, the monsters below Path of Time have grown much stronger. There is, however, a way to recover the energy from those monsters; defeat them and they'll cough up the item that stores the energy. I'll need to gather up 300 Tachions and 100 Mysteriour Powers. 4031175:# 4031175/300 4031171:# 4031171/100
I gathered up Tachions and Mysterious Powders as the replacement energy to create the new Time Sphere.

quests.name: The Time Sphere
quests.description:
I may need to take care of some more business while creating the time sphere. I should go see Mr. Bouffon.
Mr. Bouffon wanted me to collect 4031179:# through Flo... 4031179:# 4031179/1
I found the 4031179:# that Mr. Bouffon was talking about. Apparently, to defeat Papulatus, we need to be at least lvl 80 or higher...

quests.name: Papulatus
quests.description:
Everything is ready. Now all we need to do is eliminate the evil force that is Papulatus Clock.
Enter the power-generating room by finding the 4031172:# by defeating the monsters guarding the gate. I also need to place 4031179:# at the crack to call Papulatus Clock out. 4031172:# 4031172/1 Eliminate Papulatus Clock 71031#
Finally got to eliminate Papulatus Clock, the evil force-dripping monster that was hogging the Time Sphere and stealing out all kinds of power through Ludarium! The Clocktower shall emit forces of nature, and Ludibrium shall be brought in peace.
quests.requirements: Defeat Papulatus x 1, Ludibrium Medal x 1

quests.description:

I met up with Flo who told me about Papulatus. He's a monster that came through a crack in dimension to this world. I will need to get Piece of Cracked Dimension to seal up the cracked dimension. I'll need to eliminate Gigantic Spirit Viking and Grim Phantom Watch who might have entered this world with Papulatus Clock and collect the pieces of cracked dimension. Piece of Cracked Dimension A: 4031176/1 Piece of Cracked Dimension B: 4031177/1 Piece of Cracked Dimension C: 4031178/1
I gathered up 3 types of pieces of cracked dimension and gave it to Flo. I also gave Flo Piece of Cracked Dimension, which has something to do with Papulatus.

I was able to regain the lost piece of dimension from Flo. I should seriously take care of Papulatus this time.

quests.name: The Lost Medal

I lost the Piece of Cracked Dimension that Flo gave me. I better go back to Mr. Bouffon and tell him the truth
I lost the Piece of Cracked Dimension that's been given to me by Flo. After telling Mr. Bouffon of the situation, he wanted me to talk to Flo again. I'm afraid Flo may be less than pleased by the fact that I lost a very valuable Piece of Cracked Dimension.
After telling Mr. Bouffon that I lost Piece of Cracked Dimension, he wanted me to go see Flo again and talk to him. Flo was pretty upset that I lost the valuable Piece of Cracked Dimension, but then wanted me to really make sure not to ever lose it again, while giving me the last remaining Piece of Cracked Dimension that he kept to himself. He warned me that this is the last one, and that if I ever lose it again, I won't be able to get it back ever again.. I better make sure not to lose it, and give it to Mr. Bouffon.

quests.name: Papulatus's counterattack
quests.description:
I thought there would be no problem in the clock tower since I stopped the crack of dimension and got rid of Papulatus, but I still have things to do. Let's go to Mr. Bouffon.
Mr. Bouffon said that once the crack occurs on the wall of dimension, it becomes weak so that can easily have holes. He was worried that Papulatus will attack again. Mr. Bouffon asked me to check out on Flo monitoring around the operation room if Papulatus comes in.
Flo said Papulatus invaded again showing me the evidence of a piece of dimension crack. He asked me to get rid of Papulatus as I once killed Papulatus that I can do it again....

I heard recently Chief Tatamo in Leafre often looks up at the sky. Who is he waiting for Let's go see Chief Tatamo.
Chief Tatamo in Leafre was concerned about Moira, a close magician friend, because he had recently lost contact with her. Moira is very close to dragons in Minar Forest and a few days ago, she went to the forest because she heard that the dragons were under danger. Since then, she lost all contact with her. What could've possibly happened the dragons in Minar Forest and where has Moira disappeared to Wouldn't I be able to find her somewhere beyond Dragon's Forest
Chief Tatamo asked me look for magician Moira. After getting lost for awhile, I was finally able to meet Moira at the top of the entrance of the Cave of Life at the dragon's nest.

quests.name: Secret Medicine for Transformation
quests.description:
Moira, whom I met at the entrace of the Cave of Life, asked me to defeat Horntail. She said that she would make me a secret medicine that allows one to transform into a dragon, which I'll need to pass through the entrace of the cave that is guarded by Horntail's follower, Keroben . Let's get back to Moira with all the ingredients. Cornian's MarrowCornian's Marrow 4001075 / 1 Skull Shoulder PadSkull Shoulder Pad 4000267 / 1 Manon's CryManon's Cry 4001076 / 1 Tough Dragon SkinTough Dragon Skin 4001077 / 10 Cornian's DaggerCornian's Dagger 4001078 / 1
Moira told me about the war of the dragons and asked me to defeat Horntail. Moira said that she will make me a secret medicine to transform if I bring him/her all the ingredients he/she had asked me, which I would need to get passed Keroben and enter Horntail's cave.. Let's get all the ingredients to Moira. Moira made me a secret medicine that can transform me into Cornian.

Moira tells me that she was once a a squad member of the dragons, and that she is worried about other members who are scattered all over. She asked me to look for the badge of the members. She said if I bring three badges of the members and there badges I can get if I catch Zakum, Populatus and Pianus, she would appoint me as an Honorary Squad Member and show me the secret passage to cave that only members knows about.... quests.description:
I heard there's a rumor that the Baby Dragons can be evolved. Unfortunately, the only way to find out is to meet up with the grotesque-looking Karnox. I better go see him...
I better protect the Dragon's egg from the vicious egg hunters such as Lupins and Cold Eyes and need to gather 50Lupin's Bananas and 50 Cold Eye Tails.
Thankfully, Karnox acknowledged my true love for the Baby Dragon and promised to help my pet evolve.

quests.name: Pet's Evolution2
quests.description:
I have sufficiently proved my love for the Baby Dragon. However, Karnox stated that special materials are required in order to evolve the Dragon...
In order to evolve the Baby Dragon, I'll need to deliver 1 The Rock of Evolution and 10,000 mesos to Karnox.
The Baby Dragon has successfully evolved and has grown up rather nicely.

quests.name: Pet's Re-Evolution
quests.description:
If I ever get tired of the Dragon's current look, then I can re-evolve the Dragon again for a different look.
The re-evolution requires 1 The Rock of Evolution and 10,000 mesos again, just like the first time.
The re-evolution had succeeded and now the Dragon sports a different look.

quests.description:
You can make a special chocolate for the special someone with the ingredients you can gather up yourself. Go see Ace of Hearts and make the Valentine's Day Chocolate full of love ~~
Ace of Hearts said he can make a nice package for a chocolate with a heart-shaped box, laden with a special spell full of love, as long as I gather up the materials for both the chocolate and the package. Dark Chocolate, and White Chocolate can be acquired through monsters, while Heart Box and Gold Ribbon can be acquired through Coco. Ace of Hearts helped me make a Heart Chocolate laden with a spell full of love. "The power of love shall protect you..."

quests.name: Valentine's Day : Chocolate Basket
quests.description:
Apparently, Ace of Hearts can make a chocolate basket that extends the power of love using a number of Heart Chocolates.
[Ace of Hearts] said with Heart Chocolate and additional materials, he can make a Chocolate Basket that expires at a later date. Apparently, it's good for 5 days, longer than that of Heart Chocolate. Heart Chocolate 4140100 / 1 Dark Chocolate 4031110 / 1 White Chocolate 4031109 / 1 Basket 4031113 / 1 Cover Material 4031114 / 1
I was able to make a chocolate basket for the person I dearly love for the Valentine's Day through [Ace of Hearts].

I better go check and see the Maple Administrator. She may have something in store for me...
The Maple Administrator needs 100 Tree Branches, 100 Squishy Liquids, and 1 Red ribbon to make me an Easter Basket. I better go get those right now! Tree Branch 4000003/100 Squishy Liquid 4000004/100 Red Ribbon 4031192/1

I should go visit the MapleStory Administrator. I heard MapleStory is celebrating its 1st birthday, and she may have something in store for me...
The MapleStory Administrator said we'll be celebrating the anniversary in style and that there is a RED birthday present for me to look for. Now, where must that be... Birthday Present (Red) 4031306/1
I found the RED birthday present and gave it to the Maple Administrator. She opened the present for me, and gave me what was inside. That was pretty sweet!

quests.description:
Cody is supposedly in need of help. I should go see him at Henesys...
Cody said he's preparing a big party for the MapleStory staff with food and everything, but he forgot to buy the birthday candles for the cake! He seemed to be in a state of emergency, and asked me if I could gather up 10 Birthday Candles for him. Birthday Candles That's weird... Birthday Candle 4031305/10

Cody from Henesys is looking for my help. I hear that it is only for the limited time. Better go to Henesys and check out what he wants before time runs out!
Cody mentioned he is throwing a Barbecue party for Independence Day! He needs 50 Pigs' Heads, 50 Tree Branches and 50 Leathers to prepare for the Barbecue. I wonder what leather has to do with a Barbecue... Pig's Head 4000017/50 Tree Branch 4000003/50 Leather 4000021/50

quests.description:
Agent Marco of the Omega Sector is looking for heroes to protect our World. I need to get to him before all hope is lost.
Agent Marco needs help on exterminating the Plateons on Boswell Fields. I heard that a tremendous number of Plateons are taking over the Boswell Fields and coming toward the Omega Sector. I need to take out bunch of Plateons and bring 100 Plateon Helmets to Agent Marco of the Omega Sector as a proof of my mission's success. Plateon's Helmet 4000121/100
After I gave Agent Marco all 100 Plateon Helmets, I received the Stars and Stripes. This flag represents my support for the independence of our World.

quests.name: Nanuke and the Chair
quests.description:
Nanuke apparently has something for everyone. He's way out there at the Whale Island. I should go see him...
Nanuke and his huskies greeted me with open arms. He proceeded to give me a resting chair as a way of celebrating the summer. Pretty ironic, considering he lives in perhaps the coldest place in MapleStory. Anyway, I should sit on this chair and relax for a bit...

It looks like Cody of Henesys needs help finding Turkey eggs...
I'm on a mission to find as many Yellow Turkey eggs as I can for Cody, who has a strange liking for Turkey Egg omelets. I'm going to find as many as I can and bring them back to Cody for prizes! I've heard tamed turkeys can be found around Victoria Island. Yellow Turkey Egg 4031416 / 1

quests.description:
It looks like Cody of Henesys needs help finding Turkey eggs...
I'm on a mission to find as many Green Turkey eggs as I can for Cody, who has a strange liking for Turkey Egg omelets. I'm going to find as many as I can and bring them back to him for prizes! I've heard wild turkeys can be found around Ossyria and Sleepywood. Green Turkey Egg 4031417 / 1
The event is over, and I was able to help Cody find some eggs. He looked pretty happy, but I think he got so many eggs he'll start to chirp...ha!

Weighted random:
Any Class: Miniature Turkey Pet (0.2%), Elixir (5%), Corn (30%), White Potion (10%), Orange Potion (10%), Roasted Turkey (44.8%)

quests.name: Thanksgiving : Pumpkin Pie
quests.description:
Hmm...there's an old woman over in Henesys...maybe she needs some help cooking
I spoke with that kind old woman, Grandma Benson, and she needs some help with baking the pies. I've agreed to gather the ingredients for her, maybe she'll give me a pie to take with me...I hope so! Pie Crust 4031418 / 1 Pumpkin 4031419 / 1 Flour 4031420 / 1 Powder Sugar 4031421 / 1
I finished gathering the ingredients for Grandma Benson, and she can finally bake the pies. I received a taste in return, and in something that can help me during a tough battle.
quests.requirements: Pie Crust x 1, Pumpkin x 1, Flour x 1, Powder Sugar x 1

quests.name: Festival of Lights - Building the Altar
quests.description:
Hmm, that woman looks like she's preparing some sort of celebration... I should check it out.
I spoke with Hannah, and she's preparing a Festival of Lights. I've agreed to help her build the Altar by gathering 25 Altar Pieces. She mentioned that the monsters would already have an axe stuck in them, so I should hunt those.
I collected the 25 Altar Pieces and returned to Hannah. She was happy, and began building the Altar. She also mentioned that I could come back for more work when I have a chance

quests.name: Festival of Lights - Blessing the Festival
quests.description:
I promised Hannah I'd return to her once I was rested up. I should head back soon.
Upon my return, Hannah was joyous, having finished the Altar. She now needs candles to signal the start of the ceremony. I'll have to get 9 candles (she mentioned Horned Mushrooms) and bring them back so the Festival of Lights can begin.
I acquired the nine candles and gave them to Hannah. The Festival of Lights has begun!

quests.name: Graham Cracked
quests.description:
What is that old man doing over there with all those Graham Crackers
I spoke with the old man, Mr. Kit Kat, and he wants to build a Graham Cracker house, but the monsters keep eating them...not that I blame them, they look delicious...despite my hunger, I've agreed to get 50 Graham Crackers for him so he can build his dream house.
I got all the Graham Cracker pieces (and resisted the temptation to eat them), returned to Mr. Kit Kat and he gave me something tasty Banana Graham Pie. 2 of them!

quests.name: New Year's Wishes 1
quests.description:
Can't believe its New Year's already! Looks like the Maple Administrator has something for me!
Can't believe its New Year's already! Looks like the Maple Administrator has something for me!
The Maple Administrator opened my present for me! Sweet!

quests.name: New Year's Wishes 2
quests.description:

It's New Year's! I should visit the Maple Administrator to get my present opened!
The Maple Administrator opened my present for me! Sweet!

quests.name: Amoria : The Sakura Garden 1
quests.description:
I see Jacob, the garden caretaker over there! Why does he look so worried Maybe I can lend him a hand.
I talked with Jacob, who's trying to expand his garden. He's sent me to gather 25 Cherry Blossom seeds, 10 Silk Feathers and 10 Leather. I've heard that Sakura celions might have the blossom seeds. In return for this, he's agreed to give me some high-quality potions. I bet they taste delicious...
I got the materials that Jacob needed to expand the garden. He mentioned he might have more work for me if I needed it. I'll pay him a visit soon!
quests.requirements: Cherry Blossom Seed x 25, Silk Feather x 10, Leather x 10

quests.name: Amoria : The Sakura Garden 2 - Finishing Touches
quests.description:
Jacob mentioned he'd need more help. Perhaps I should pay him a visit
I went to see Jacob again, and his Sakura Garden is just about done. He wants to do something special for the first guests, so I've agreed to provide 20 White/Purple Gift Boxes, 10 Lupin Dolls and 10 Toy Baby Seals. Shouldn't be too tough, and he's mentioned something special if I finish...
I finished getting everything for Jacob and returned to him for my reward-Blossom Juice! It tastes great!
quests.requirements: Lupin Doll x 10, Toy Baby Seal x 10, White/Purple Ribbon Gift Box x 20

quests.name: Amoria : Cupid's Courier - Beginner
quests.description:
The wife of a sailor, eh I'll bet she needs some help.
I spoke with the lovely Angelique, and I'm going to deliver 25 Stiff Feathers to her husband, Richard, for her. He works on Tae Gong's ship in Aqua Road. Once I have everything, I'll head there, drop everything off, and let Angelique know her husband has everything.

quests.description:
I heard there's a new girl at the Amoria Hair Salon that needs material for her new hair gel. I wonder what she'd offer in return
I talked to Claudia, she needs 25 Squishy Liquids for her new hair gel. She's offered to give me a free EXP Hair Salon coupon in return. She seems like a nice enough gal...
I got the Squishy Liquids for Claudia and she gave me an EXP Hair Salon coupon for her shop. I can use it once to get my hair done for free!

quests.description:

quests.name: Amoria : Red Dahlia - Warrior
quests.description:
Hmm, there's a man who looks a little distraught... should I help him
I went and spoke with Ben, and he's trying to make a special flower for his wife called the Red Dahlia. He got injured and needs someone to collect the materials for him. I agreed to help, and bring back 30 Stiff Feathers and 3 Diamond Ore he needs to make the flower. Seems like a nice enough guy, shame he got injured, but I can get him what he wants...
I retrieved all the materials Ben needed and he'll be able to make the Red Dahlia. In return for my help, he gave me a scroll that will help me in my travels.

quests.description:
An unhappy couple in Amoria I should go find out what's wrong...
I spoke with Gary and Shatima, and it looks like their rings were broken and taken in to 20 Ring Fragments by some Tweeters. Looks like I'll have to clip some wings to find them all...
I returned to the Rings to Gary and Shatima, and now they can get married! Phew, a lot of work, but well worth it!
quests.rewards_items: Gelt Chocolate, 2x Speed Potion, 5x Power Elixir

quests.name: Amoria : Circle of Trust 2 (A Bond is Forged)
quests.description:
An unhappy couple in Amoria I should go find out what's wrong...
I spoke with Gary and Shatima, and it looks like their rings were broken and taken in to 20 Ring Fragments by some Tweeters. When I have them all, I am going to head over to Moony.
I returned to the Ring fragments to Moony, and now Gary and Shatima can get married! Phew, a lot of work, but well worth it!

quests.name: Spot On : An Interesting Chore
quests.description:
Mom and Dad need some help at home. I'd better go visit and see how I can help them.
I visited Mom and Dad and they looked pretty happy to see me. They need a Mouse for their new computer, and heard that Mr. Spot would have one. He's in Kerning City, so I'd better get a move on.
I returned to Mom and Dad with the Mouse, and they gave me Allowance. Now I can return to Mr. Spot and get a Nexon Cash Card!

quests.name: Spot On : Go See Mr. Spot
quests.description:
Mr. Spot is in Kerning City, and he has something that could help Mom and Dad. I'd better go see my parents first before I visit him.
I visited Mr. Spot and got the Mouse for Mom and Dad. I can get a Nexon Cash Card from Mr. Spot if I ask them for Allowance. I'll cross my fingers...
I got my Nexon Cash Card! I should keep it, because it will turn into Maple Points soon! SWEET!
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Nexon Cash Card - 100 points (95%), Nexon Cash Card - 250 points (5%)

quests.name: Circle of Trust - Repaired Ring
quests.description:
I've lost the Ring I got from Moony on the way back to Gary and Shatima. Maybe Moony can help me out...
Moony has the Ring! I am saved. This time I should be very careful.
I got the Repaired Ring from Moony again, and now Gary and Shatima can get married! Phew, a lot of work, but well worth it!

quests.name: Easter : Easter Basket
quests.description:
I better go check and see the Maple Administrator. She may have something in store for me...
The Maple Administrator needs 100 Tree Branches, 100 Squishy Liquids, and 1 Red ribbon to make me an Easter Basket. I better go get those right now! Tree Branch 4000003/100 Squishy Liquid 4000004/100 Red Ribbon 4031192/1
I got the Easter Basket from the Maple Administrator. Mad Bunny may need this for something... I should go see him now.
quests.requirements: Tree Branch x 100, Squishy Liquid x 100, Red Ribbon x 1

quests.name: Easter : Mad Bunny's Easter(Yellow)
quests.description:
I heard Mad Bunny isn't too happy with Easter. I should go talk to him and see what's up...
Mad Bunny needs 10 Yellow Easter Eggs and an Easter Basket from me. He may be one angry bunny, but he did promise to pay me well for my service... Yellow Easter Egg 2022065/10 Easter Basket 4031283/1

quests.description:
I should go visit the MapleStory Administrator. I heard MapleStory is celebrating its 2nd birthday, and she may have something in store for me...
The MapleStory Administrator said we'll be celebrating the anniversary in style and that there is a RED birthday present for me to look for. Now, where must that be... Birthday Present (Red) 4031306/1
I found the RED birthday present and gave it to the Maple Administrator. She opened the present for me, and gave me what was inside. That was pretty sweet!

quests.name: 2nd Anniversary : Cody's Quest
quests.description:
Cody is supposedly in need of help. I should go see him at Henesys...
Cody said he's preparing a big party for the MapleStory staff with food and everything, but he forgot to buy the birthday candles for the cake! He seemed to be in a state of emergency, and asked me if I could gather up 10 Birthday Candles for him. Birthday Candles That's weird...
I gave him the 10 Birthday Candles he requested. He seemed very much relieved by the fact that the party won't be ruined after all. He gave me a Maple Flag as a reward. Wow, I haven't seen these in a while!

quests.name: About the Amorian Challenge!
quests.description:
mes the Wise has good news for me. It looks like his brother, Amos the Strong, has finished his hunting ground for married couples. I should stop by and get some more info!
I visited Ames the Wise, and he explained the Amoria Party Quest in detail I must visit Amos the Strong at the end of Purplewood Forest, and if I'm married, I can enter. I can either bring my spouse or go at it solo. I must team up with 5 other married people, and from there, the adventure begins!
That wasn't so bad! Amos the Strong seems much different from his brother Ames--he had muscles coming out of his muscles! To enter his hunting ground, I must be married, and can either bring my spouse or go at it with 5 other married people. I should visit Amoria more often...I wonder what else is in this land...

quests.name: Summer Break: Cody's BBQ - Start
quests.description:
Hooray for Summer! I heard Cody's having a barbecue! I better head over and see if I can help!
I spoke with Cody, and it looks like he needs help. I'll need to bring 10 Charcoals 10 BBQ Sauces and 10 Maple Raw Meat to Cody so he can finish cooking. Just the sound of all that makes me hungry!
I got all the ingredients Cody needed to start the barbecue! With the items he gave me, I can continue to enjoy the summer in style!

quests.name: Teo's reminiscence
quests.description:
I think I can get some help from Teo in Lith Harbor...
I met Teo at Lith Harbor. Teo told me I remind him of his youth when he went for many journeys. Reminiscing his past, Teo told me he wanted to help me. He said if I bring 50 Red Snail Shell and 30 Squishy Liquid, he will recognize my potentials and support me...ha! This is a Piece of cake!
I proved how good I am to Teo at Lith Harbor. Teo has acknowleged my abilities and financially supported me. With this support, I'll be a great adventurer.
quests.requirements: Red Snail Shell x 50, Squishy Liquid x 30

quests.name: Beat the Heat <Easy> - 1st Stage
quests.description:
Maple Administrator has come up with an event for the summer. Where must the admin be
As summer rolls on, The Maple Adminstrator has prepared an event called 'Beat the Heat' for the health of the users, most of which would be in front of the air-conditioner or a fan. As a warm up, the administrator requested that I defeat 50 Red Snails and 20 Orange Mushrooms... sounds like fun. Red Snail 90512# Orange Mushroom 90511#
I met the Maple Administrator, and passed the 1st Stage of the Easy level of Beat the Heat.
quests.requirements: Defeat Orange Mushroom x 20, Defeat Red Snail x 50

quests.name: Beat the Heat <Easy> - 2nd Stage
quests.description:
I should go visit Maple Administrator for Beat the Heat, 2nd Stage.
For the 2nd Stage task, the Maple Administrator asked me to gather up 10 Blue Present Box for Trainings#, which can be obtained by hunting Green Mushroom and Dark Stump. Blue Present Box for Training 4031167/10
I met the Maple Administrator, and passed the 2nd stage of the Easy level of Beat the Heat.
quests.requirements: Blue Present Box for Training x 10

quests.name: Beat the Heat <Easy> - 3rd Stage
quests.description:
I should go visit Maple Administrator for Beat the Heat, 3rd Stage.
For the 3rd Stage task, the Maple Administrator wanted me to defeat Axe Stump and Blue Mushroom, 25 each, while collecting 30 Bubbling's Huge Bubbles from Bubbling. Axe Stump 90532# Blue Mushroom 90531# Bubbling's Huge Bubble 4000037/30
I passed the 'Beat the Heat' Challenge that MapleStory prepared for us. Just like he/she said, I better stop spending so much time in front of air-conditioners and fans, and go out instead and lead an active life.
quests.requirements: Defeat Blue Mushroom x 25, Defeat Axe Stump x 25, Bubbling's Huge Bubble x 30

quests.name: Torr's Horn
quests.description:
I heard Torr of Happyville has lost something very important...
I heard Torr of Happyville lost something very important, so I went to see her. I found her crying, and it turns out that... she lost her horn ! How can you lose a horn She asked me to find her horn but... where can it be Torr's Horn 4031063/1
I found Torr's horn at the Cash Shop, and gave it back to her. She was ecstatic, to say the least. I hope she doesn't lose it anymore...

quests.name: Valentine's Day : Heart Chocolate
quests.description:
You can make a special chocolate for the special someone with the ingredients you can gather up yourself. Go see Ace of Hearts and make the Valentine's Day Chocolate full of love ~~
Ace of Hearts said he can make a nice package for a chocolate with a heart-shaped box, laden with a special spell full of love, as long as I gather up the materials for both the chocolate and the package. Dark Chocolate, and White Chocolate can be acquired through monsters, while Heart Box and Gold Ribbon can be acquired through Coco. Dark Chocolate 4031110 / 1 White Chocolate 4031109 / 1 Heart Box 4031111 / 1 Gold Ribbon 4031112 / 1
Ace of Hearts helped me make a Heart Chocolate laden with a spell full of love. "The power of love shall protect you..."
quests.requirements: White Chocolate x 1, Dark Chocolate x 1, Heart Box x 1, Gold Ribbon x 1

Apparently, Ace of Hearts can make a chocolate basket that extends the power of love using a number of Heart Chocolates.

I was able to make a chocolate basket for the person I dearly love for the Valentine's Day through [Ace of Hearts].
quests.requirements: Heart Chocolate x 1, White Chocolate x 1, Dark Chocolate x 1, Basket x 1, Cover Material x 1

quests.name: 지우개가 필요한 휴즈
quests.description:
휴즈를 찾아가보자. 도움이 필요한 것 같다.
휴즈가 연구를 진행하기 위해서 지우개가 필요하다고 했다.
휴즈가 필요한 지우개를 구해줬다.
quests.requirements: Stump Eraser x 1, Mushmom Eraser x 1, Lupin Eraser x 1, Wraith Eraser x 1, Slime Eraser x 1, Octopus Eraser x 1

quests.name: 외계인 그레이에게 복수하기
quests.description:
외계인 그레이를 찾아가보자.
외계인 그레이가 아무 것도 아닌 지우개에 관심을 보이다니... 저번에 당한 일을 복수 할 수 있는 좋은 기회다...
아무 쓸모 없는 지우개들을 외계인 그레이에게 넘기고 좋은 물건을 받았다.
quests.requirements: Stump Eraser x 1, Mushmom Eraser x 1, Lupin Eraser x 1, Wraith Eraser x 1, Slime Eraser x 1, Octopus Eraser x 1

quests.name: 누구도 뽑을 수 없는 검
quests.description:
페리온에 기묘한 검이 있다고 한다. 한 번 가볼까
재 속에 길다란 검이 꽂혀져 있어서 다가가 봤더니, 갑자기 중후한 목소리가 들렸다. 목소리는 자신이 이 검의 주인이라 말하며, 정령의 잔재에 묶여 버린 검의 주인이 되어 검에 갇힌 그를 풀어 달라고 했다. 그러기 위해서는 몬스터 지우개와 Undine's Cloth이 필요 하다는데... Undine's Cloth 4001115/1 Stump Eraser 4001038/1 Mushmom Eraser 4001039/1 Lupin Eraser 4001040/1 Wraith Eraser 4001041/1 Slime Eraser 4001042/1 Octopus Eraser 4001043/1
몬스터 지우개와 Undine's Cloth을 모두 가져가자 검의 힘을 찾아 제어하게 된 모양이다. Flaming Katana를 얻었다. 이제 이 검의 주인도 자유를 찾았겠지.
quests.requirements: Stump Eraser x 1, Mushmom Eraser x 1, Lupin Eraser x 1, Wraith Eraser x 1, Slime Eraser x 1, Octopus Eraser x 1, Undine's Cloth x 1

quests.name: 육각 수정 목걸이와 물개 방석
quests.description:
엘리니아의 아르웬은 보석을 무척 좋아한다고 하는데...
육각 수정 목걸이를 본 아르웬의 눈이 심상치 않다. 꼭 목걸이를 갖고 싶다는 아르웬. 육각 수정 목걸이와 몬스터 지우개를 준다면, 아끼던 물개 쿠션을 주겠다고 말하는데... Hexagon Necklace 4001116/1 Stump Eraser 4001038/1 Mushmom Eraser 4001039/1 Lupin Eraser 4001040/1 Wraith Eraser 4001041/1 Slime Eraser 4001042/1 Octopus Eraser 4001043/1
육각 수정 목걸이와 몬스터 지우개를 주고 사랑스러운 물개 쿠션을 받았다.
quests.requirements: Stump Eraser x 1, Mushmom Eraser x 1, Lupin Eraser x 1, Wraith Eraser x 1, Slime Eraser x 1, Octopus Eraser x 1, Hexagon Necklace x 1

quests.name: Cody's Valentine
quests.description:
I heard Cody was acting like he's madly in love. I better go see for it myself.
Cody seemed to have a big-time crush on Maya, and wanted to surprise her with a Valentine's day gift. Since he couldn't go anywhere, he asked me if I could deliver chocolate for him, so I obliged. No one's better at making chocolate Cookers. Heart Chocolate 04140100/1
On behalf of Cody, I gave Maya the Heart Chocolate. She seemed very much ecstatic. Hopefully this is the start of something good...
